title: PivotOPD: Learning to Recover from Pivotal Mistakes in Multi-Turn Agents
title_zh: PivotOPD：学习在多轮智能体中从关键错误中恢复

paragraphs.en: tcboxmath \tl_set:Ne \tcbhighmath tcbhighmath yh0068@princeton.edu, ahatamizadeh@nvidia.com
paragraphs.zh: tcboxmath \tl_set:Ne \tcbhighmath tcbhighmath yh0068@princeton.edu，ahatamizadeh@nvidia.com

paragraphs.en: Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) is a promising approach for training language agents, providing dense teacher supervision on student-generated trajectories. However, in multi-turn interaction, an incorrect action changes the states the student encounters later, so errors compound across turns. In our preliminary experiments across three Qwen3 models (8B–235B), we find that more than half of the failed rollouts contain a pivotal mistake , an action that moves the agent farther from completing the task, and this mistake typically occurs early. These pivotal mistakes often remain recoverable: guiding the model for only a few turns after the pivotal turn can restore task success. We therefore propose PivotOPD , an on-policy distillation framework that jointly trains the student to prevent pivotal mistakes and to recover from the states they create. At each pivotal mistake, a teacher model provides a gold action and then names a recovery action at each of the next few turns. Preventive distillation uses the gold action with reverse KL to steer the student away from the pivotal mistake, while recovery distillation uses the recovery actions with forward KL to transfer recovery behaviors that the student rarely samples. Against 13 13 baselines on ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-based QA, PivotOPD achieves the strongest average performance for both Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3-8B students, improving over the strongest baseline on ALFWorld by + 5.5 % +5.5\% with the 1.7B student. The gains also transfer to another model family on the software engineering domain, where PivotOPD raises the resolve rate of a Nemotron-3.5 student on SWE-Bench Verified by + 3.2 % +3.2\% .
paragraphs.zh: 摘要：在线策略蒸馏（OPD）是一种训练语言智能体的有前景的方法，它能为学生模型生成的轨迹提供密集的教师监督。 然而，在多轮交互中，一个错误的动作会改变学生模型后续遇到的状态，因此错误会在不同回合中累积。 在针对三种 Qwen3 模型（8B–235B）的初步实验中，我们发现超过一半的失败执行流程都包含一个关键性错误——即一个使智能体更难以完成任务的动作，且这种错误通常发生在早期阶段。 这些关键性错误往往仍具有可恢复性：在关键回合之后仅引导模型几个回合，即可恢复任务的成功完成。 因此，我们提出了 PivotOPD——一种在线策略蒸馏框架，该框架能同步训练学生模型，以预防关键性错误，并使其能够从自身造成的状态中恢复。 在每个关键性错误发生时，教师模型会提供一个黄金动作，然后在接下来的几个回合中分别指定一个恢复动作。 预防性蒸馏使用反向 KL 散度与黄金动作相结合，引导学生模型避开关键性错误；而恢复性蒸馏则使用正向 KL 散度与恢复动作相结合，以迁移那些学生模型极少采样的恢复行为。 在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和基于搜索的 QA 任务中，PivotOPD 相较于 13 个基线模型取得了最强的平均性能，其中对于 Qwen3-1.7B 和 Qwen3-8B 学生模型均表现最佳，在 ALFWorld 上比最强基线模型提升了 +5.5%。 这些改进也迁移到了软件工程领域的另一个模型家族中：PivotOPD 将 Nemotron-3.5 学生在 SWE-Bench Verified 上的解决率提升了 +3.2%。

paragraphs.en: Language agents are increasingly capable of solving complex tasks through multi-turn interactions [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 ] . To improve their performance, recent work has adopted on-policy distillation (OPD) as an effective training paradigm [ 9 , 10 ] , since it provides dense, token-level teacher supervision on trajectories that the student generates itself [ 11 , 12 , 13 ] . However, OPD is more challenging in multi-turn settings because each action changes the external environment, which then returns new observations and determines which actions are available in later turns [ 14 , 15 ] . A single incorrect action can lead to error accumulation , in which the student ends up in states created by its own mistake and diverges further from the teacher over the turns that follow [ 16 , 14 , 15 , 17 ] . Existing multi-turn OPD methods address error accumulation by reweighting turns or restricting which turns receive the distillation signal [ 10 , 17 , 15 , 18 ] , but leave open whether such failures hinge on a single decisive mistake and whether the student can still recover from it.
paragraphs.zh: 语言智能体通过多轮交互解决复杂任务的能力正日益增强 [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 ] 。 为了提升其性能，近期研究采用了在线策略蒸馏（OPD）这一有效的训练范式 [ 9 , 10 ] ，因为它能为学生智能体自身生成的轨迹提供密集的、基于词元的教师级监督 [ 11 , 12 , 13 ] 。 然而，在多轮交互场景中，OPD 更具挑战性，因为每次行动都会改变外部环境，而环境随后会返回新的观察结果，并决定后续回合中哪些行动是可行的 [ 14 , 15 ] 。 单次错误行动可能导致错误累积：学生智能体最终会陷入由自身失误造成的状态，并在后续回合中进一步偏离教师智能体的路径 [ 16 , 14 , 15 , 17 ] 。 现有的多轮 OPD 方法通过重新分配各回合的权重或限制哪些回合接收蒸馏信号来应对错误累积问题 [ 10 , 17 , 15 , 18 ] ，但尚未明确此类失败是否源于某个决定性的单一错误，以及学生智能体能否从中恢复。

paragraphs.en: To answer these questions, we analyze failed rollouts in ALFWorld [ 6 ] , where the agent completes household goals, such as heating an egg, through textual actions ( Section D.5 ), and summarize the results in Figure 1 . Its symbolic oracle reads the full environment state and computes the remaining optimal trajectory, i.e., the shortest action sequence that completes the task, at every turn. Across three Qwen3 models (8B–235B) [ 19 ] , more than half of the failed rollouts contain a pivotal mistake : an action that lengthens the remaining optimal trajectory or makes the task unsolvable. We call the turn where it is committed a pivotal turn . The first one typically arrives early, and all three models waste most of the remaining turns without recovering ( Figure 1 a). In counterfactual replays of Qwen3-8B’s failures, correcting the pivotal turn with the oracle action raises the replayed success from 8 % 8\% to 59 % 59\% ( Figure 1 b). To test whether a failure can be repaired after the mistake, we keep the mistake and apply the oracle action at the next two turns, which still reaches 58 % 58\% . Therefore, pivotal mistakes are largely recoverable.
paragraphs.zh: 为回答这些问题，我们分析了 ALFWorld [6] 中失败的执行过程。在该环境中，智能体通过文本动作（D.5 节）完成诸如加热鸡蛋等家庭任务，相关结果总结于图 1。 其符号化神谕会读取完整的环境状态，并在每一步计算剩余的最优轨迹，即完成任务所需的最短动作序列。 在三种 Qwen3 模型（8B–235B）[19] 中，超过一半的失败执行过程都包含一个关键性错误：某个使剩余最优轨迹变长或导致任务无法解决的动作。 我们将发生这一错误的步骤称为关键步骤。 第一个关键步骤通常较早出现，且三种模型在后续的大部分步骤中都无法恢复（图 1a）。 在 Qwen3-8B 失败案例的反事实重演中，用神谕动作修正关键步骤后，重演的成功率从 8% 提升至 59%（图 1b）。 为测试错误发生后能否修复失败，我们在保留该错误的同时，在接下来两步中应用了神谕动作，此时成功率仍达到 58%。 因此，关键性错误在很大程度上是可以恢复的。

paragraphs.en: Existing training methods rarely teach this recovery, because they learn mostly from the student’s own trajectories, and these rarely contain a recovery. Outcome-based RL rewards a recovery only when a rollout happens to find one, and its group-relative advantage is zero whenever every rollout of a task fails [ 20 ] . Methods that assign credit to individual turns or focus on the turns that decide the outcome share this limitation [ 21 , 22 , 23 ] , and so does OPD. In our analysis, standard OPD lowers the failure rate from 79 % 79\% to 56 % 56\% of held-out tasks, while failures after a pivotal turn only fall from 51 % 51\% to 49 % 49\% ( Figure 1 c). Although OPD reduces the probability of the committed mistake, the oracle action still has less than 1 % 1\% probability at every evaluated pivotal turn ( Appendix A ). The student therefore lacks a direct learning signal at the states its own mistakes create.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的训练方法很少教授这种恢复机制，因为它们主要从学生智能体自身的轨迹中学习，而这些轨迹中很少包含恢复过程。 基于结果的强化学习只有在一次展开恰好找到恢复机制时才会奖励该机制，而当某项任务的所有展开都失败时，其相对于群体的优势为零 [ 20 ] 。 那些将功劳分配给单个回合或专注于决定最终结果的回合的方法也存在这一局限性 [ 21 , 22 , 23 ] ，OPD 也不例外。 在我们的分析中，标准的 OPD 方法将保留任务中的失败率从 79 % 79\% 降低到 56 % 56\%，而关键回合之后的失败率仅从 51 % 51\% 降至 49 % 49\%（图 1c）。 尽管 OPD 降低了已犯错误的概率，但在所有评估的关键回合中，神谕动作的概率仍然低于 1 % 1\%（附录 A）。 因此，学生在自身错误所创造的状态下缺乏直接的学习信号。

paragraphs.en: To provide this signal, we introduce PivotOPD , which augments group-based RL with dense token-level supervision concentrated at pivotal turns and the turns that follow them ( Figure 2 ). Since most environments offer no oracle, PivotOPD estimates pivotal turns through pivot detection : a teacher model, a larger LLM in our main setting, reads each rollout in hindsight, selects a few candidate turns where the student may have gone wrong, and names a gold action at each. We treat a candidate turn as pivotal when the student’s committed action differs from the gold action. On ALFWorld, at least one detected pivotal turn falls within one turn of the oracle-labeled one in 77.8 % 77.8\% of failed rollouts on average, at least twice the rate of randomly chosen turns ( Table S.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 为了提供这一信号，我们引入了 PivotOPD，它将基于群体的强化学习（RL）与密集的令牌级监督相结合，这些监督集中在关键转折点及其后续步骤上（图 2）。 由于大多数环境没有标准答案，PivotOPD 通过“枢轴检测”来估计关键转折点：一个教师模型（在我们主要设置中是一个更大的 LLM）会回顾性地读取每个执行轨迹，选择学生可能出错的一些候选转折点，并在每个转折点上指定一个标准动作。 当学生已采取的动作与标准动作不同时，我们将该候选转折点视为关键转折点。 在 ALFWorld 中，平均而言，在 77.8% 的失败执行轨迹中，至少有一个检测到的关键转折点与标准答案标注的转折点相差一个步骤以内，这一比例是随机选择的转折点的两倍之多（表 S.1）。

paragraphs.en: PivotOPD obtains its token-level targets from a privileged self-teacher , the frozen student conditioned on a hint that names the teacher model’s action, so the teacher only names actions [ 9 , 24 ] . At each pivotal turn, preventive distillation re-scores the student’s recorded response with the self-teacher hinted with the gold action and minimizes a reverse KL loss, which shifts the student toward the gold action and away from the committed mistake. After each pivotal turn, recovery distillation has the teacher model name a recovery action at each of the next few turns and trains the student, without the hint, on the responses that the hinted self-teacher writes toward them. Its mass-covering forward KL loss raises the probability of recovery actions that the student rarely samples [ 25 ] .
paragraphs.zh: PivotOPD 从其特权自教师处获取词元级目标；该自教师是一个基于提示的冻结学生模型，而提示会指明教师模型应采取的行动，因此教师仅指定行动 [9, 24]。 在每个关键回合中，预防性蒸馏会使用包含黄金行动的提示重新评分学生模型记录的回答，并最小化反向 KL 损失，从而将学生模型引导至黄金行动，使其远离已犯的错误。 每个关键回合结束后，恢复性蒸馏会要求教师模型在接下来的几个回合中指定恢复行动，并在没有提示的情况下，基于提示自教师针对这些行动生成的回答来训练学生模型。 其覆盖广泛的正向 KL 损失会提升学生模型极少采样的恢复行动的概率 [25]。

paragraphs.en: Results. Against 13 13 baselines, PivotOPD achieves the best average performance on ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-based QA for both Qwen3 students ( Table 1 ), and at 8B it recovers from pivotal mistakes more than three times as often as standard OPD ( Figure 5(b) ). paragraphs.en: We ask whether failures hinge on a single decisive mistake, whether that mistake remains recoverable, and whether standard OPD repairs it ( Figure 1 ). On ALFWorld [ 6 ] , a symbolic oracle computes the remaining optimal trajectory from the full environment state, and we call its next action the oracle action . We roll out Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-30B-A3B , and Qwen3-235B-A22B [ 19 ] on 140 140 held-out tasks, replay each with this oracle, and analyze Qwen3-8B below ( Appendix A ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们探讨失败是否取决于某个决定性的单一错误，这个错误是否仍有挽回可能，以及标准的 OPD 方法能否修复它（图 1）。 在 ALFWorld [6] 中，一个符号化预言机基于完整的环境状态计算出剩余的最优轨迹，我们将它的下一个动作称为预言机动作。 我们在 140 个预留任务上运行了 Qwen3-8B、Qwen3-30B-A3B 和 Qwen3-235B-A22B [19]，使用这个预言机对每个任务进行重演，并在下文分析了 Qwen3-8B（附录 A）。

paragraphs.en: A single pivotal turn often determines the outcome, yet it is recoverable. Across the three models, 59 % 59\% of the failed trajectories contain an action that lengthens the remaining optimal trajectory or makes the task unsolvable ( Appendix A ). We call such an action a pivotal mistake , and the turn where it is committed a pivotal turn (formalized in Section 3.1 ). In failed trajectories with a pivotal turn, the first one typically arrives early, at a median of turn 8 8 – 12 12 out of 30 30 ( Figure 1 a). All three models then waste an average of 18 18 – 21 21 more turns without recovering from it.
paragraphs.zh: 一个关键的转折点通常决定最终结果，但这种情况仍有可能挽回。 在三款模型中，59% 的失败轨迹包含某种会延长剩余最优路径或使任务无法完成的操作（附录 A）。 我们将此类操作称为“关键性错误”，而执行该操作的回合则称为“关键转折点”（在第 3.1 节中进行了形式化定义）。 在存在关键转折点的失败轨迹中，第一个关键转折点通常较早出现，平均出现在第 8–12 个回合（共 30 个回合）（图 1a）。 随后，三款模型平均会浪费 18–21 个额外回合，且无法从该错误中恢复。

paragraphs.en: Among the 72 72 failed Qwen3-8B trajectories with a pivotal turn, correcting the first pivotal turn with the oracle action raises the replayed success from 8 % 8\% to 59 % 59\% , whereas correcting a later turn helps far less ( Figure 1 b). To test whether the post-mistake state is still recoverable by some admissible action sequence, we leave the mistake in place and force the oracle action at the next two turns, which still reaches 58 % 58\% . Learning to recover after a pivotal mistake can therefore be nearly as effective as preventing it.
paragraphs.zh: 在 72 条出现关键转折且最终失败的 Qwen3-8B 轨迹中，使用“神谕”行动纠正第一个关键转折，可使重播成功率从 8% 提升至 59%，而纠正后续转折的帮助则小得多（图 1b）。 为了检验错误发生后的状态是否仍可通过某些可行的行动序列恢复，我们保留该错误不变，并强制在接下来两个回合采取“神谕”行动，此时成功率仍可达 58%。 因此，学会在关键性错误后恢复，其效果几乎与预防该错误相当。

paragraphs.en: Standard on-policy distillation does not repair pivotal turns. We train Qwen3-8B for 120 120 steps with standard OPD, in which a privileged copy of the model provides token-level supervision on the model’s own responses [ 9 ] . At each checkpoint, we use the same oracle to categorize the remaining failures ( Figure 1 c). On held-out tasks, OPD lowers the overall failure rate by 23.6 % 23.6\% but the rate of failures after a pivotal turn by only 2.1 % 2.1\% . Most of the gain comes from failures without a pivotal turn, which fall by 21.4 % 21.4\% . OPD does suppress the committed mistake, moving its median probability from 0.999 0.999 to below 10 − 5 10^{-5} , yet the oracle action stays below 10 − 2 10^{-2} at every pivotal turn ( Appendix A ). A group of eight rollouts is therefore not expected to sample it even once, so it receives little direct reinforcement.
paragraphs.zh: 标准的在线策略蒸馏无法修复关键转折点。 我们使用标准 OPD 对 Qwen3-8B 进行 120 个步骤的训练，在此过程中，模型的一个特权副本会对模型自身的响应提供词元级别的监督 [9]。 在每个检查点，我们都使用相同的预言机对剩余的失败进行分类（图 1c）。 在预留的任务上，OPD 将总体失败率降低了 23.6%，但关键转折点后的失败率仅降低了 2.1%。 大部分增益来自没有关键转折点的失败，其失败率下降了 21.4%。 OPD 确实抑制了已发生的错误，将其概率中位数从 0.999 降低到低于 10^{-5}，但在每个关键转折点处，预言机动作仍保持在 10^{-2} 以下（附录 A）。 因此，一个包含八个展开步骤的组预计甚至不会采样到它一次，所以它获得的直接强化很少。

paragraphs.en: Section 2 shows that more than half of the failed rollouts contain a recoverable pivotal mistake that standard OPD does not repair. PivotOPD therefore concentrates the dense token-level signal of on-policy distillation at pivotal turns and the turns that follow them. It adds three components to group-based RL ( Figure 2 ): pivot detection ( Section 3.2 ), where a teacher model names the actions that the student should take at and after pivotal turns, and preventive and recovery distillation ( Section 3.3 ), where a privileged self-teacher provides the dense token-level targets. Section 3.4 analyzes the learning signal of recovery distillation, and Algorithm 1 in Appendix B summarizes one training step.
paragraphs.zh: 第 2 节表明，超过一半的失败执行过程都包含一个可恢复的关键性错误，而标准的 OPD 无法修复该错误。 因此，PivotOPD 将在线蒸馏中密集的标记级信号集中在关键转折点以及紧随其后的转折点上。 它为基于群体的强化学习增加了三个组件（图 2）：关键点检测（第 3.2 节），其中教师模型会指出学生在关键转折点及之后应采取的动作；以及预防与恢复蒸馏（第 3.3 节），其中具备特权信息的自教师提供密集的标记级目标。 第 3.4 节分析了恢复蒸馏的学习信号，附录 B 中的算法 1 总结了一个训练步骤。

paragraphs.en: We model an agentic task as a partially observable Markov decision process [ 26 ] . At turn t t , the environment is in a latent state s t s_{t} and emits an observation o t o_{t} , where o 0 o_{0} states the task instruction. The agent holds a context c t = ( o 0 , y 0 , o 1 , y 1 , … , o t ) c_{t}=(o_{0},y_{0},o_{1},y_{1},\dots,o_{t}) , which is the history of observations and responses up to the current observation. The current observation specifies the admissible actions 𝒜 ⁡ ( c t ) \mathcal{A}(c_{t}) , which ALFWorld and WebShop list explicitly, Search-based QA defines as any search query or answer, and SWE-Bench defines as any call to the agent’s tools or the final patch submission. The student policy generates the next response y t ∼ π θ ( ⋅ ∣ c t ) y_{t}\sim\pi_{\theta}(\cdot\mid c_{t}) , which includes free-form reasoning followed by a committed action a t := act ⁡ ( y t ) ∈ 𝒜 ⁡ ( c t ) a_{t}:=\operatorname{act}(y_{t})\in\mathcal{A}(c_{t}) . A trajectory τ = { ( o t , y t ) } t = 0 T − 1 \tau=\{(o_{t},y_{t})\}_{t=0}^{T-1} records one attempt of T T turns and receives an outcome score R ⁡ ( τ ) R(\tau) when it ends.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将智能体任务建模为一个部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程 [26]。 在第 t 轮中，环境处于一个潜在状态 s_t，并产生一个观测 o_t，其中 o_0 表示任务指令。 智能体持有上下文 c_t = (o_0, y_0, o_1, y_1, …, o_t)，即当前观测之前的观测与响应的历史。 当前观测决定了允许采取的动作集合 𝒜(c_t)。ALFWorld 和 WebShop 会明确列出这些动作，基于搜索的问答任务将其定义为任何搜索查询或答案，而 SWE-Bench 则将其定义为对智能体工具的任意调用或最终的补丁提交。 学生策略生成下一个响应 y_t ∼ π_θ(⋅∣c_t)，该响应包含自由形式的推理过程，随后是一个确定动作 a_t := act(y_t) ∈ 𝒜(c_t)。 轨迹 τ = {(o_t, y_t)}_{t=0}^{T-1} 记录了一次包含 T 轮的操作尝试，并在操作结束时获得一个结果得分 R(τ)。

paragraphs.en: Pivotal mistake & pivotal turn. We now formalize the pivotal mistakes of Section 2 . We write L ⁡ ( s t ) L(s_{t}) for the length of the remaining optimal trajectory, which is the minimum number of turns needed to complete the task from the latent state s t s_{t} , with L ⁡ ( s t ) = ∞ L(s_{t})=\infty once the task is unsolvable. A turn t t is a pivotal turn if its committed action a t a_{t} increases this length, i.e., L ⁡ ( s t + 1 ) > L ⁡ ( s t ) L(s_{t+1})>L(s_{t}) , and a t a_{t} is then a pivotal mistake . The pivotal turns of a trajectory τ \tau form the set { t : L ⁡ ( s t + 1 ) > L ⁡ ( s t ) } \{t:L(s_{t+1})>L(s_{t})\} , which can contain several turns even when τ \tau succeeds. For each failed trajectory, Section 2 uses the smallest element of this set. Pivot detection estimates these turns without access to L L .
paragraphs.zh: 关键性错误与关键性转折。 我们现在将第 2 节中的关键性错误形式化。 我们用 L(s_t) 表示剩余最优轨迹的长度，即从潜在状态 s_t 开始完成该任务所需的最少转折次数；一旦任务无法解决，则 L(s_t)=\infty。 如果某个转折 t 所执行的动作 a_t 使该长度增加，即 L(s_{t+1})>L(s_t)，则称其为关键性转折，此时 a_t 就是一个关键性错误。 一条轨迹 τ 的关键性转折构成集合 {t: L(s_{t+1})>L(s_t)}，即使 τ 最终成功，该集合也可能包含多个转折。 对于每条失败的轨迹，第 2 节都使用该集合中的最小元素。 关键性转折点检测无需访问 L 即可估算这些转折。

paragraphs.en: Pivotal turns and gold actions. After collecting the rollouts of a training step, we prompt the teacher model to read each trajectory τ \tau together with its outcome R ⁡ ( τ ) R(\tau) and to select up to m m candidate turns where the student may have gone wrong. At each candidate turn t t , the teacher model also names a gold action a t ∗ ∈ 𝒜 ⁡ ( c t ) a^{*}_{t}\in\mathcal{A}(c_{t}) , which serves as its estimate of the oracle action. A candidate turn does not necessarily contain a mistake, since the student’s committed action a t a_{t} may already agree with the gold action. We therefore treat a candidate turn as pivotal only when the two disagree, i.e., a t ≠ a t ∗ a_{t}\neq a^{*}_{t} . The teacher-detected pivotal turns of a training step form the set 𝒯 pivot \mathcal{T}_{\text{pivot}} . At least one teacher-detected pivotal turn falls within one turn of the oracle-labeled pivotal turn in 77.8 % 77.8\% of failed ALFWorld trajectories on average over our two teachers, at least twice the rate of randomly chosen turns ( Table S.1 ). Appendix B compares pivot detection with this oracle labeling.

paragraphs.en: Privileged self-teacher. To turn a gold or recovery action into a token-level target, we provide it to the frozen student π θ ¯ \pi_{\bar{\theta}} as a hint . For an action a a , the hint h ⁡ ( a ) h(a) is a short instruction that presents a a as a reasonable action at the current turn and asks the model to reason toward it in its own words. Conditioning π θ ¯ \pi_{\bar{\theta}} on this hint gives a privileged self-teacher π θ ¯ ( ⋅ ∣ c , h ( a ) ) \pi_{\bar{\theta}}(\cdot\mid c,h(a)) , which differs from the student only through the information that the action provides [ 9 , 24 ] . This keeps the distillation target in the student’s own reasoning style.

paragraphs.en: Benchmarks. We evaluate PivotOPD on four multi-turn agentic benchmarks. (1) ALFWorld [ 6 ] is an embodied household environment with six task types, where the agent completes language-specified goals through textual actions. (2) WebShop [ 7 ] is a simulated e-commerce website where the agent searches for and purchases a product that satisfies an instruction. (3) Search-based QA [ 8 ] requires the agent to answer questions from seven open-domain QA datasets [ 28 , 29 , 30 , 31 , 32 , 33 , 34 ] by calling a search engine. (4) SWE-Bench Verified [ 35 ] requires the agent to resolve real GitHub issues by exploring and editing a Python repository, and we use it to test transfer to software engineering and to a different model family ( Section 4.2 ). Section D.5 shows an example episode from each of the first three benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: 基准测试。 我们在四个多轮智能体基准测试上评估了 PivotOPD。 （1）ALFWorld [6] 是一个具身化的家庭环境，包含六种任务类型，其中智能体通过文本动作完成语言指定的目标。 （2）WebShop [7] 是一个模拟的电子商务网站，智能体需要在此搜索并购买满足指令要求的产品。 （3）基于搜索的问答 [8] 要求智能体通过调用搜索引擎，回答来自七个开放领域问答数据集 [28, 29, 30, 31, 32, 33, 34] 的问题。 （4）SWE-Bench Verified [35] 要求智能体通过探索并编辑 Python 代码库来解决真实的 GitHub 问题，我们用它来测试向软件工程领域以及不同模型家族的迁移能力（第 4.2 节）。 D.5 节展示了前三个基准测试中每个测试的一个示例回合。

sents.en: (3) Search-based QA [ 8 ] requires the agent to answer questions from seven open-domain QA datasets [ 28 , 29 , 30 , 31 , 32 , 33 , 34 ] by calling a search engine.
sents.zh: （3）基于搜索的问答 [8] 要求智能体通过调用搜索引擎，回答来自七个开放领域问答数据集 [28, 29, 30, 31, 32, 33, 34] 的问题。

sents.en: (4) SWE-Bench Verified [ 35 ] requires the agent to resolve real GitHub issues by exploring and editing a Python repository, and we use it to test transfer to software engineering and to a different model family ( Section 4.2 ).
sents.zh: （4）SWE-Bench Verified [35] 要求智能体通过探索并编辑 Python 代码库来解决真实的 GitHub 问题，我们用它来测试向软件工程领域以及不同模型家族的迁移能力（第 4.2 节）。

sents.en: Section D.5 shows an example episode from each of the first three benchmarks.
sents.zh: D.5 节展示了前三个基准测试中每个测试的一个示例回合。

paragraphs.en: Models & training configurations. We use Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3-8B [ 19 ] as students, paired with a Qwen3-30B-A3B teacher and a Qwen3.5-122B-A10B teacher, respectively. Every method that uses a teacher, including the baselines, uses the same teacher for a given student. In the self-distillation setting, the student serves as its own teacher. On the first three benchmarks, all methods share the same training data, 160 160 training steps, and 8 8 rollouts per task ( Sections D.1 and D.4 ).

paragraphs.en: Baselines. Besides the base model, we compare PivotOPD against three groups of methods, namely (1) RL and self-distillation, with GRPO [ 20 ] , OPSD [ 9 ] , RLSD [ 36 ] , and SDAR [ 37 ] ; (2) turn-level distillation for multi-turn agents, with TurnOPD [ 10 ] , TCOD [ 15 ] , SOD [ 17 ] , StepOPSD [ 18 ] , and AgentOPSD [ 38 ] ; and (3) high-level guidance through skills or pivotal turns, with Skill-GRPO and OPID [ 23 ] , Skill-SD [ 39 ] , and PivotRL [ 22 ] ( Section D.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 基线模型。 除了基础模型外，我们还对 PivotOPD 与三组方法进行了比较，即：（1）强化学习（RL）与自蒸馏方法，包括 GRPO [ 20 ]、OPSD [ 9 ]、RLSD [ 36 ] 和 SDAR [ 37 ]；（2）针对多轮智能体的回合级蒸馏方法，包括 TurnOPD [ 10 ]、TCOD [ 15 ]、SOD [ 17 ]、StepOPSD [ 18 ] 和 AgentOPSD [ 38 ]；以及（3）通过技能或关键回合进行的高层引导方法，包括 Skill-GRPO 和 OPID [ 23 ]、Skill-SD [ 39 ] 以及 PivotRL [ 22 ]（见 D.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation. We report the task success rate on each ALFWorld task type, the exact-match accuracy on each QA dataset, and both the normalized score and the success rate on WebShop. The ALFWorld and Search-based QA averages are unweighted means over task types and datasets, respectively. Each experiment is run with three random seeds, and we report the average. We select each checkpoint on a separate validation set and evaluate it on held-out test sets of 274 274 ALFWorld tasks, 500 500 WebShop instructions, and 725 725 QA questions, sampling at temperature 0.4 0.4 ( Section D.2 ).

paragraphs.en: PivotOPD attains the best average performance on all three main benchmarks, especially where successful rollouts are scarce. As Table 1 shows, PivotOPD ranks first on all eight per-benchmark averages. With the 1.7B student, it improves over the strongest baseline by + 5.5 % +5.5\% on ALFWorld and + 5.9 % +5.9\% on Search-based QA. With the 8B student, the margins are smaller but remain at least + 1.8 % +1.8\% . The comparison with GRPO, which learns from outcome rewards alone, shows that PivotOPD helps most where successful rollouts are scarce. With the 1.7B student, it improves over GRPO the most on Clean, Cool, and Heat, which are the three ALFWorld task types that the base model solves least often. When every rollout of a task fails, group-relative advantages provide no learning signal ( Proposition 2 in Appendix C ), whereas recovery distillation still trains the recovery action at the states where the student gets stuck ( Section 3.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: PivotOPD 在所有三个主要基准测试中均实现了最佳平均性能，尤其是在成功部署稀少的情况下。 如表 1 所示，PivotOPD 在全部八个基准测试的平均排名中均位列第一。 使用 1.7B 学生模型时，它在 ALFWorld 上的表现比最强基线模型提升了 +5.5% +5.5\%，在基于搜索的问答任务上提升了 +5.9% +5.9\%。 使用 8B 学生模型时，提升幅度较小，但仍至少为 +1.8% +1.8\%。 与仅从结果奖励中学习的 GRPO 相比，可以看出 PivotOPD 在成功部署稀少的情况下效果最为显著。 使用 1.7B 学生模型时，它在 Clean、Cool 和 Heat 任务上的提升幅度最大，这三个任务类型是基础模型解决频率最低的类型。 当某项任务的每次部署都失败时，组内相对优势无法提供任何学习信号（附录 C 中的命题 2），而恢复蒸馏仍能在学生模型陷入停滞的状态下训练恢复动作（第 3.4 节）。

sents.en: PivotOPD attains the best average performance on all three main benchmarks, especially where successful rollouts are scarce.
sents.zh: PivotOPD 在所有三个主要基准测试中均实现了最佳平均性能，尤其是在成功部署稀少的情况下。

sents.en: As Table 1 shows, PivotOPD ranks first on all eight per-benchmark averages.
sents.zh: 如表 1 所示，PivotOPD 在全部八个基准测试的平均排名中均位列第一。

sents.en: With the 1.7B student, it improves over the strongest baseline by + 5.5 % +5.5\% on ALFWorld and + 5.9 % +5.9\% on Search-based QA.
sents.zh: 使用 1.7B 学生模型时，它在 ALFWorld 上的表现比最强基线模型提升了 +5.5% +5.5\%，在基于搜索的问答任务上提升了 +5.9% +5.9\%。

sents.en: With the 8B student, the margins are smaller but remain at least + 1.8 % +1.8\% .
sents.zh: 使用 8B 学生模型时，提升幅度较小，但仍至少为 +1.8% +1.8\%。

sents.en: The comparison with GRPO, which learns from outcome rewards alone, shows that PivotOPD helps most where successful rollouts are scarce.
sents.zh: 与仅从结果奖励中学习的 GRPO 相比，可以看出 PivotOPD 在成功部署稀少的情况下效果最为显著。

sents.en: With the 1.7B student, it improves over GRPO the most on Clean, Cool, and Heat, which are the three ALFWorld task types that the base model solves least often.
sents.zh: 使用 1.7B 学生模型时，它在 Clean、Cool 和 Heat 任务上的提升幅度最大，这三个任务类型是基础模型解决频率最低的类型。

sents.en: When every rollout of a task fails, group-relative advantages provide no learning signal ( Proposition 2 in Appendix C ), whereas recovery distillation still trains the recovery action at the states where the student gets stuck ( Section 3.4 ).
sents.zh: 当某项任务的每次部署都失败时，组内相对优势无法提供任何学习信号（附录 C 中的命题 2），而恢复蒸馏仍能在学生模型陷入停滞的状态下训练恢复动作（第 3.4 节）。

paragraphs.en: PivotOPD turns partial progress into successful task completion. On WebShop, the normalized score gives partial credit for partially satisfying the instruction, whereas the success rate counts only fully completed tasks. With the 1.7B student, RLSD attains the highest score among the baselines. PivotOPD improves over RLSD by only + 1.2 % +1.2\% in score but by + 14.1 % +14.1\% in success rate. With both students, its gains over GRPO are likewise larger in success rate than in score. The larger gains in success rate are consistent with the effect of recovery distillation, which teaches the student to recover from pivotal mistakes that would otherwise leave a partially completed task unfinished. Indeed, removing recovery distillation ( K = 0 K=0 ) substantially lowers the best WebShop validation score of the 1.7B student ( Figure 6 ).
paragraphs.zh: PivotOPD 将部分进展转化为任务的成功完成。 在 WebShop 中，归一化分数会因部分满足指令而给予部分分数，而成功率则仅计算完全完成的任务。 使用 1.7B 学生模型时，RLSD 在基线方法中获得了最高分数。 PivotOPD 的分数仅比 RLSD 高出 +1.2% +14.1%，但成功率提升了 +14.1% +14.1%。 对于两种学生模型，其相对于 GRPO 的提升在成功率方面也大于分数提升。 成功率的更大提升与恢复蒸馏的效果一致：恢复蒸馏教会学生从关键错误中恢复，否则这些错误会导致部分完成的任务最终未完成。 事实上，移除恢复蒸馏（K = 0 K=0）会显著降低 1.7B 学生模型在 WebShop 验证集上的最佳分数（图 6）。

sents.en: PivotOPD turns partial progress into successful task completion.
sents.zh: PivotOPD 将部分进展转化为任务的成功完成。

sents.zh: PivotOPD 的分数仅比 RLSD 高出 +1.2% +14.1%，但成功率提升了 +14.1% +14.1%。

sents.en: With both students, its gains over GRPO are likewise larger in success rate than in score.
sents.zh: 对于两种学生模型，其相对于 GRPO 的提升在成功率方面也大于分数提升。

sents.en: The larger gains in success rate are consistent with the effect of recovery distillation, which teaches the student to recover from pivotal mistakes that would otherwise leave a partially completed task unfinished.
sents.zh: 成功率的更大提升与恢复蒸馏的效果一致：恢复蒸馏教会学生从关键错误中恢复，否则这些错误会导致部分完成的任务最终未完成。

sents.en: Indeed, removing recovery distillation ( K = 0 K=0 ) substantially lowers the best WebShop validation score of the 1.7B student ( Figure 6 ).
sents.zh: 事实上，移除恢复蒸馏（K = 0 K=0）会显著降低 1.7B 学生模型在 WebShop 验证集上的最佳分数（图 6）。

paragraphs.en: PivotOPD remains effective without a stronger external teacher. In its main setting, PivotOPD uses a stronger teacher to name the gold and recovery actions. To test whether it still works without such a teacher, we use the student as its own teacher for PivotOPD and for every baseline that uses a teacher. As shown in Figure 3 , PivotOPD achieves the best performance on all three benchmarks, outperforming the strongest baseline on each by at least + 1.5 % +1.5\% . Relative to training under the stronger teacher ( Table 1 ), it stays within 5 % 5\% on Search-based QA and in WebShop success rate but falls 10.2 % 10.2\% short on ALFWorld. These results suggest that much of the gain comes from where and how the teacher intervenes rather than from teacher capacity alone.
paragraphs.zh: PivotOPD 在没有更强外部智能体的情况下仍然有效。 在其主要设置中，PivotOPD 使用一个更强的智能体来命名黄金动作和恢复动作。 为了测试它在没有这种智能体的情况下是否仍然有效，我们将学生智能体用作 PivotOPD 以及所有使用智能体的基线模型自身的智能体。 如图 3 所示，PivotOPD 在所有三个基准测试中都取得了最佳性能，在每一项测试中都比最强的基线模型至少高出 +1.5%（+1.5\%）。 与在更强智能体下的训练相比（表 1），它在基于搜索的问答和 WebShop 成功率上的差距保持在 5%（5\%）以内，但在 ALFWorld 上的表现低了 10.2%（10.2\%）。 这些结果表明，大部分性能提升源于智能体干预的位置和方式，而不仅仅是智能体的能力本身。

paragraphs.en: PivotOPD also improves a different model family on software engineering. The experiments so far all use Qwen3 students, so we next ask whether the gains of PivotOPD carry over to another model family and to software engineering. To this end, we train Nemotron-3.5-SFT with Nemotron-3-Super as the teacher, both from the Nemotron model family [ 40 ] , and evaluate its resolve rate on SWE-Bench Verified ( Section D.6 ). Since SWE-Bench episodes are long and containerized, we adapt pivot detection and the recovery budget to them ( Section D.6 ). As shown in Figure 4 , PivotOPD raises the resolve rate by + 3.2 % +3.2\% and closes roughly a third of the gap to the teacher, whereas standard OPD improves it by only + 0.2 % +0.2\% .
paragraphs.zh: PivotOPD 还提升了软件工程中另一个模型系列的性能。 到目前为止的所有实验都使用了 Qwen3 学生模型，因此我们接下来要探究的是：PivotOPD 带来的增益是否也能迁移到另一个模型系列和软件工程中。 为此，我们以 Nemotron-3-Super 为教师模型，训练了来自 Nemotron 模型系列的 Nemotron-3.5-SFT [40]，并在 SWE-Bench Verified（第 D.6 节）上评估了其问题解决率。 由于 SWE-Bench 的任务流程较长且采用容器化方式，我们对枢轴检测机制和恢复预算进行了相应调整（第 D.6 节）。 如图 4 所示，PivotOPD 将问题解决率提升了 +3.2%（+3.2\%），并缩小了与教师模型之间约三分之一的差距；而标准 OPD 仅将其提升了 +0.2%（+0.2\%）。

sents.en: PivotOPD also improves a different model family on software engineering.
sents.zh: PivotOPD 还提升了软件工程中另一个模型系列的性能。

paragraphs.en: We now study the recovery behavior behind these gains, asking (1) whether PivotOPD learns to recover from pivotal mistakes, (2) what makes this recovery learnable, (3) why recovery distillation provides a learning signal, and (4) how many recovery turns to train.
paragraphs.zh: 我们现在研究这些增益背后的恢复行为，并提出以下问题：(1) PivotOPD 是否学会了从关键性错误中恢复；(2) 是什么使得这种恢复具有可学习性；(3) 为什么恢复蒸馏能够提供学习信号；以及 (4) 需要训练多少次恢复步骤。

paragraphs.en: PivotOPD learns to effectively recover from pivotal mistakes. We replay the 72 72 ALFWorld pivotal mistakes of the motivating analysis ( Section 2 ) and let each trained policy continue after the pivotal mistake ( Section E.2 ). In the example of Figure 5(a) , after the student takes a tomato instead of the requested egg, the base model commits the tomato to the microwave and never finds the egg, whereas PivotOPD sets the tomato aside, takes the egg, and completes the task. Across all 72 72 pivotal mistakes, PivotOPD recovers roughly nine times as often as the base model and in the fewest turns ( Figure 5(b) ). Since the trained policy never sees the oracle, these recoveries also show that the mistakes are recoverable without its privileged information. It also raises the recovery rate by + 26.9 % +26.9\% over the preventive-only variant, i.e., PivotOPD with recovery budget K = 0 K=0 , so explicit recovery distillation improves recovery beyond what preventive training alone achieves.
paragraphs.zh: PivotOPD 学会了有效地从关键错误中恢复。 我们重演了动机性分析（第 2 节）中提到的 72 个 ALFWorld 关键错误，并让每个训练好的策略在发生关键错误后继续执行（第 E.2 节）。 在图 5(a) 的例子中，当学生拿起了番茄而不是所需的鸡蛋时，基础模型会将番茄放入微波炉且永远找不到鸡蛋，而 PivotOPD 则会先将番茄放在一边，再拿起鸡蛋并完成任务。 在所有 72 个关键错误中，PivotOPD 恢复成功的频率大约是基础模型的九倍，并且所需步数最少（图 5(b)）。 由于训练好的策略从未看到过“神谕”，这些恢复案例也表明，无需依赖其特权信息，这些错误也是可以恢复的。 与仅采用预防措施的变体（即恢复预算 K = 0 的 PivotOPD）相比，它还将恢复率提升了 +26.9%；因此，显式的恢复蒸馏使恢复效果超越了仅靠预防性训练所能达到的水平。

sents.en: PivotOPD learns to effectively recover from pivotal mistakes.
sents.zh: PivotOPD 学会了有效地从关键错误中恢复。

paragraphs.en: Recovery requires supervision at the right turns and on the right actions. To see what makes this recovery learnable, we train variants of PivotOPD on ALFWorld that each remove or replace a single component ( Table 2 and Appendix E ). Neither the preventive-only nor the recovery-only variant matches the average success rate of PivotOPD , so the two distillation terms are complementary. This holds even though the preventive-only variant compensates with a larger preventive weight ( Appendix E ). The budget ablation shows a larger effect of recovery: the selected budget raises the best validation score over K = 0 K=0 by 5.4 5.4 points on ALFWorld, 21.5 21.5 on WebShop, and 2.4 2.4 on Search-based QA ( Figure 6 ). When we inject the same hints at random turns, the average success rate is the lowest among all variants, indicating that supervision must land at pivotal turns. Similarly, when a generic reflection prompt replaces the gold action in each hint, the average success rate stays close to that of preventive only but drops sharply on Pick2 ( Table S.4 ), suggesting that the hint must name the correct action on task types whose decisions cannot be inferred from the observations alone.
paragraphs.zh: 恢复过程需要在正确的回合和正确的行动上进行监督。 为了了解这种恢复机制为何具有可学习性，我们在 ALFWorld 上训练了 PivotOPD 的多个变体，每个变体都移除或替换了单个组件（表 2 和附录 E）。 仅预防或仅恢复的变体都无法达到 PivotOPD 的平均成功率，因此这两个蒸馏项是互补的。 尽管仅预防的变体通过更大的预防权重进行了补偿（附录 E），但这一结论依然成立。 预算消融分析显示，恢复机制的影响更大：在 ALFWorld 上，所选预算使最佳验证分数在 K = 0 的基础上提升了 5.4 分，在 WebShop 上提升了 21.5 分，在基于搜索的 QA 任务上提升了 2.4 分（图 6）。 当我们在随机回合注入相同的提示时，平均成功率在所有变体中最低，这表明监督必须作用于关键回合。 同样地，当通用反思提示取代每个提示中的黄金行动时，平均成功率与仅预防的情况相近，但在 Pick2 任务上急剧下降（表 S.4），这说明对于那些无法仅从观察中推断出决策的任务类型，提示必须明确提及正确的行动。

paragraphs.en: Recovery distillation restores the learning signal that on-policy updates lose after a pivotal mistake. Beyond where and what to supervise, we now ask why recovery distillation provides a learning signal when the student rarely samples the recovery action. Proposition 1 predicts that without recovery distillation, the student stays far from its privileged self-teacher after a pivotal mistake. In Figure 7 , we track the forward KL divergence from the self-teacher to the student, which measures how far the student remains from its self-teacher ( Section E.3 ). After the mistake, the preventive-only student indeed remains at least twice as far from its self-teacher as PivotOPD at every displayed turn. This gap persists well beyond the single recovery turn that PivotOPD trains in this run ( K = 1 K=1 ), suggesting that the learned recovery carries over to later turns rather than fitting the trained turn alone.
paragraphs.zh: 恢复蒸馏能够恢复策略更新在关键错误之后所丢失的学习信号。 除了监督的位置和对象之外，我们现在还要追问：当学生智能体很少采样恢复动作时，恢复蒸馏为何仍能提供学习信号？ 命题 1 预测，如果没有恢复蒸馏，学生在发生关键错误后会与自身的特权自教师保持较大距离。 在图 7 中，我们追踪了自教师到学生的前向 KL 散度，该指标衡量了学生智能体与其自教师之间的偏离程度（见 E.3 节）。 在发生错误后，仅采用预防策略的学生智能体在每个展示回合中，确实比 PivotOPD 至少远其自教师两倍。 这种差距在 PivotOPD 本次运行中所训练的单次恢复回合（K = 1）之后仍持续存在，表明所学到的恢复策略能够延续到后续回合，而不仅仅是针对训练回合本身进行拟合。

paragraphs.en: The best recovery budget varies across benchmarks. It is K = 1 K=1 on WebShop and Search-based QA but K = 2 K=2 on ALFWorld ( Figure 6 ). One plausible explanation, consistent with Proposition 3 in Appendix C , is that ALFWorld tasks require longer sequences of fine-grained actions after a mistake. Section E.1 reports the training compute overhead of each budget.
paragraphs.zh: 最佳恢复预算因基准测试而异。 在 WebShop 和基于搜索的 QA 中，K = 1 K=1；但在 ALFWorld 中，K = 2 K=2（图 6）。 一种合理的解释是（与附录 C 中的命题 3 一致），ALFWorld 的任务在出现错误后需要更长的细粒度动作序列。 E.1 节报告了每种预算的训练计算开销。

paragraphs.en: Our baselines span RL and on-policy self-distillation, alone or combined [ 20 , 9 , 36 , 37 , 41 ] , turn-level distillation for multi-turn agents [ 10 , 15 , 17 , 18 , 38 ] , and guidance from skills or pivotal turns [ 39 , 23 , 22 ] , all of which learn from responses that the student samples. Several locate outcome-deciding turns, and OPID’s turn-level skills are closest to our preventive distillation. PivotOPD additionally trains the student on self-teacher responses at the states that its own mistakes create, so it teaches recovery actions that the student rarely samples ( Appendix F ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们的基线方法涵盖了强化学习（RL）和在线策略自我蒸馏（单独使用或结合使用 [20, 9, 36, 37, 41]）、多轮智能体的回合级蒸馏 [10, 15, 17, 18, 38]，以及来自技能或关键回合的引导 [39, 23, 22]，这些方法都通过学生模型采样的响应进行学习。 一些方法会定位决定结果的回合，而 OPID 的回合级技能与我们的预防性蒸馏最为接近。 PivotOPD 还会在学生模型因自身错误所处的状态上，使用自我教师的响应进行训练，从而教会学生模型那些它很少采样的恢复动作（附录 F）。

paragraphs.en: We showed on ALFWorld that failed rollouts often contain a recoverable pivotal mistake that standard OPD does not repair, and proposed PivotOPD , which distills a privileged self-teacher at and after pivotal turns. PivotOPD attains the best average performance against 13 13 baselines on three agentic benchmarks and recovers from pivotal mistakes far more often than standard OPD. It also improves a different model family on software engineering.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 ALFWorld 中表明，失败的执行流程通常包含一个可以纠正的关键性错误，而标准的 OPD 无法修复这一问题；为此，我们提出了 PivotOPD，它会在关键转折点以及之后阶段提炼出一个具有特权能力的自我教师。 在三个智能体基准测试中，PivotOPD 相较于 13 个基线模型取得了最佳平均性能，并且比标准 OPD 更频繁地从关键性错误中恢复过来。 它还在软件工程领域提升了另一类模型的性能。

sents.en: We showed on ALFWorld that failed rollouts often contain a recoverable pivotal mistake that standard OPD does not repair, and proposed PivotOPD , which distills a privileged self-teacher at and after pivotal turns.
sents.zh: 我们在 ALFWorld 中表明，失败的执行流程通常包含一个可以纠正的关键性错误，而标准的 OPD 无法修复这一问题；为此，我们提出了 PivotOPD，它会在关键转折点以及之后阶段提炼出一个具有特权能力的自我教师。

sents.en: PivotOPD attains the best average performance against 13 13 baselines on three agentic benchmarks and recovers from pivotal mistakes far more often than standard OPD.
sents.zh: 在三个智能体基准测试中，PivotOPD 相较于 13 个基线模型取得了最佳平均性能，并且比标准 OPD 更频繁地从关键性错误中恢复过来。

sents.en: It also improves a different model family on software engineering.
sents.zh: 它还在软件工程领域提升了另一类模型的性能。

paragraphs.en: We roll out three models, Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-30B-A3B, and Qwen3-235B-A22B, on the 140 140 held-out ALFWorld tasks of the valid_seen split, sampling at temperature 0.4 0.4 with a cap of 30 30 turns and a history window of 5 5 turns. The analysis runs on ALFWorld because it is the one benchmark of the three that provides a symbolic oracle, and the oracle is what makes pivotal turns identifiable without a model in the loop. PivotOPD does not use this oracle during training ( Section 3.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们在有效已见（valid_seen）分集中预留的 140 个 ALFWorld 任务上部署了三种模型：Qwen3-8B、Qwen3-30B-A3B 和 Qwen3-235B-A22B，采样温度为 0.4，最大对话轮数为 30 轮，历史窗口为 5 轮。 分析在 ALFWorld 上运行，因为在这三个基准中，只有它提供了符号化“神谕”，而正是这个“神谕”使得无需模型介入循环也能识别出关键对话轮次。 PivotOPD 在训练过程中并未使用这个“神谕”（第 3.2 节）。

paragraphs.en: Every recorded trajectory is replayed in the environment alongside the ALFWorld PDDL oracle, which recomputes the number of turns that an optimal trajectory still needs, i.e., L ⁡ ( s t ) L(s_{t}) in Section 3.1 . A turn is pivotal when the action committed there raises this number or leaves the task unsolvable. Among the failed trajectories, 72 72 of 111 111 contain a pivotal turn for Qwen3-8B, 35 35 of 70 70 for Qwen3-30B-A3B, and 48 48 of 81 81 for Qwen3-235B-A22B, which amounts to 155 155 of 262 262 across the three models. The analysis uses the first pivotal turn of each failed trajectory, with the oracle action at that turn as the correction. Before this turn, the agent has not moved away from completing the task, so correcting it gives a clean counterfactual. The replay reproduces the recorded outcome for all 420 420 trajectories, so the counterfactuals below are exact rather than approximate.

paragraphs.en: Qwen3-8B fails 111 111 of the held-out tasks, and 72 72 of these failed trajectories contain a pivotal turn. From the pivotal turn of each, we replay the remainder of the trajectory with the same model under the five interventions of Figure 1 b: no intervention, the model resampled at the pivotal turn, the oracle action forced at another turn drawn at random from the turns that are not pivotal, the oracle action forced at the pivotal turn itself, and the oracle action forced at each of the two turns after the mistake, with the mistake left in place and the oracle re-queried at every forced turn. Each intervention is repeated four to eight times per trajectory. The later-turn intervention is a control for the position of the correction, and it controls for position only when the drawn turn lands after the pivotal turn, since an earlier correction also erases the model’s own mistake. We therefore report it over the 51 51 trajectories where the drawn turn does land later, while the other interventions use all 72 72 . This control forces the oracle action later in the trajectory and has fewer turns left to work with, but success after correcting the pivotal turn is flat in the position of that turn, between 57 % 57\% and 63 % 63\% across position tertiles. Extending the correction after the mistake from two turns to three adds about four points, so the two-turn result is not an artifact of how many turns we correct.

paragraphs.en: For each intervention, we average the replayed success over the replays of each trajectory and compute a 95 % 95\% bootstrap confidence interval over trajectories ( 4,000 4{,}000 draws, seed 0 0 ), which we give in brackets in percent. Without intervention, the replayed success is 8.2 % 8.2\% [ 3.8 , 13.0 ] [3.8,13.0] , and resampling the pivotal turn gives 6.9 % 6.9\% [ 2.4 , 12.2 ] [2.4,12.2] . Forcing the oracle action at a later turn gives 17.2 % 17.2\% [ 8.3 , 27.5 ] [8.3,27.5] . Correcting the pivotal turn instead gives 59.0 % 59.0\% [ 48.3 , 69.8 ] [48.3,69.8] , and forcing the oracle action at the two turns after the mistake gives 58.3 % 58.3\% [ 47.6 , 69.1 ] [47.6,69.1] , or 62.2 % 62.2\% [ 51.4 , 72.9 ] [51.4,72.9] with three forced turns. paragraphs.en: Qwen3-8B is trained from its base checkpoint for 120 120 steps with standard on-policy distillation. Here, standard OPD is the OPSD baseline of Table 1 , which distills a privileged self-teacher [ 9 ] under the configuration of Sections D.1 and D.3 . For Figure 1 c, we roll out each saved checkpoint on the same 140 140 held-out tasks, label the rollouts with the oracle exactly as above, and split each checkpoint’s failures into those that fail at a pivotal turn and those whose trajectory contains no pivotal turn and leaves the task unfinished. Among the 72 72 tasks that the base model loses at a pivotal turn, roughly seven in ten are lost again after distillation, and about half of the 72 72 repeat the same kind of mistake. We score the probability that the model assigns to the oracle action under the frozen policy at each pivotal turn, before and after distillation. Distillation moves the median probability of the committed mistake from 0.999 0.999 to below 10 − 5 10^{-5} and raises the median probability of the oracle action by ten orders of magnitude. The raised probability nevertheless stays below 10 − 2 10^{-2} at every pivotal turn, so a group of 8 8 rollouts is not expected to sample the oracle action even once. This run is shorter than the 160 160 -step runs of Section 4.1 , and its numbers are not comparable to Table 1 , though both sides of every comparison within this analysis are measured under the same protocol.
paragraphs.zh: Qwen3-8B 基于其基础检查点，通过标准的策略内蒸馏进行了 120 步训练。 此处，标准 OPD 是表 1 中的 OPSD 基线方法，该方法在 D.1 和 D.3 节的配置下对一个特权自教师 [9] 进行蒸馏。 对于图 1c，我们在相同的 140 个预留任务上运行每个保存的检查点，像上文一样用神谕标签标记这些运行结果，并将每个检查点的失败分为两类：一类是在关键步骤上失败的，另一类是轨迹中未出现任何关键步骤且任务未完成的情况。 在基础模型于关键步骤上失败的 72 个任务中，大约十分之七在蒸馏后仍然失败，而在这 72 个任务中，约有一半重复了同一种错误。 我们在每个关键步骤上，分别记录蒸馏前后模型在冻结策略下对神谕动作分配的概率。 蒸馏将已发生错误的动作的中位概率从 0.999 降低到低于 10^{-5}，同时将神谕动作的中位概率提升了十个数量级。 尽管如此，在每个关键步骤上，这一提升后的概率仍低于 10^{-2}，因此一组 8 次运行预计甚至不会采样到一次神谕动作。 此次运行的步数少于第 4.1 节中 160 步的运行，其数据与表 1 不可比，但本分析中的每一组比较都是在相同协议下测量的。

paragraphs.en: This appendix details the components of PivotOPD summarized in Section 3 , and Algorithm 1 presents one training step.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录详细说明了第 3 节中概述的 PivotOPD 的各个组件，而算法 1 则展示了一个训练步骤。

paragraphs.en: For each trajectory, the teacher returns one structured reply containing a trajectory summary, a trajectory-level lesson, a per-turn lesson, and gold-action blocks that name an action for up to m m candidate turns. The trajectory-level lesson is the brief feedback on the whole trajectory that Section 3.3 mentions. It is inserted into the prompt at every turn of the trajectory and scored with the distillation advantage A ℓ distill A^{\mathrm{distill}}_{\ell} , weighted by w traj w_{\text{traj}} in place of w prev w_{\text{prev}} . For brevity, Eq. 3 omits this term. Replies that name no action contribute only the lesson signal and never trigger recovery. The hint h ⁡ ( a ) h(a) renders the action as a short passage. The passage states that a a is a reasonable approach at this turn and instructs the model to reason toward it from scratch, in its own style, without referencing, acknowledging, or quoting the hint. The exact templates are in Section D.4 .

paragraphs.en: The teacher’s free-text action is matched onto the admissible set by normalized exact equality, then by equality after stripping articles, then by containment by a unique admissible command, and finally by highest token overlap above a fixed threshold, with a strict winner. If none of the rules resolves a reply, the recovery is dropped. For the open action spaces of Search-based QA and SWE-Bench, no matching is required: the teacher’s named action is taken verbatim, subject to the same schema-validity check as student actions, i.e., a well-formed search query or answer for Search-based QA, and for SWE-Bench, a call that parses against the scaffold’s tool interface and executes in the task container.
paragraphs.zh: 教师自由文本动作首先通过归一化精确相等匹配到可接受集合中，接着通过去除冠词后的相等性匹配，然后由唯一可接受命令的包含关系匹配，最后通过高于固定阈值的最高词元重叠度匹配，并严格确定一个获胜者。 如果没有任何规则能够解决回复，则放弃恢复操作。 对于基于搜索的问答和 SWE-Bench 中的开放动作空间，无需进行匹配：教师命名的动作将逐字执行，但需接受与学生动作相同的模式有效性检查，即对于基于搜索的问答，需为格式正确的搜索查询或答案；而对于 SWE-Bench，则需调用一个能够根据框架工具接口解析并在任务容器中执行的操作。

paragraphs.en: A candidate turn is pivotal when the student’s committed action differs from the gold action after both are lowercased and their whitespace is collapsed. In Search-based QA, both actions are first rewritten in the forms search[ ⋅ \cdot ] and answer[ ⋅ \cdot ] . A response without a parsable action counts as a mismatch. Free-text actions such as search queries rarely match verbatim, so candidate turns with such actions are usually treated as pivotal. This is one source of the false positives discussed in the next paragraph.
paragraphs.zh: 当学生的执行动作与标准动作在转换为小写并合并空白字符后存在差异时，候选回合即被视为关键。 在基于搜索的问答系统中，两种动作首先会被改写为 search[ ⋅ \cdot ] 和 answer[ ⋅ \cdot ] 的形式。 无法解析出明确动作的回应将被视为不匹配。 自由文本形式的动作（如搜索查询）很少能完全逐字匹配，因此包含此类动作的候选回合通常被视为关键。 这是下一段所讨论的误判来源之一。

paragraphs.en: Pivot detection relaxes the oracle labeling of Section 2 in four ways. (1) The teacher’s judgment replaces the oracle. Although ALFWorld provides an oracle, we do not use it during training, so that PivotOPD stays identical across benchmarks and does not depend on a benchmark-specific oracle. (2) A trajectory may contain several pivotal turns, because the agent can move away from completing the task more than once. (3) Pivot detection covers successful trajectories as well as failed ones, because a successful trajectory can still contain a pivotal mistake from which the student happens to recover. (4) Disagreement with the gold action replaces an increase in L L , so an equally reasonable alternative action can be flagged as pivotal. Such false positives are inexpensive. The preventive weight w prev w_{\text{prev}} is small ( Table S.3 ), and recovery distillation at such a turn still trains the student toward the teacher’s next action at a state that the student actually visited.
paragraphs.zh: 枢轴检测以四种方式放宽了第 2 节中的神谕标注。 (1) 教师的判断取代了神谕。 尽管 ALFWorld 提供了神谕，但我们并未在训练中使用它，因此 PivotOPD 在各个基准测试中保持一致，且不依赖于特定于某个基准测试的神谕。 (2) 一条轨迹可能包含多个关键转折点，因为智能体可以多次偏离任务完成的方向。 (3) 枢轴检测既涵盖成功轨迹，也涵盖失败轨迹，因为一条成功轨迹仍然可能包含一个关键性错误，而学生恰好从该错误中恢复过来。 (4) 与标准动作的不一致取代了 L L 的增加，因此一个同样合理的替代动作也可能被标记为关键动作。 这类误判成本较低。 预防权重 w prev w_{\text{prev}} 很小（表 S.3），并且在此类转折点处的恢复蒸馏仍然会引导学生朝着教师在该状态下实际访问过的状态所采取的下个动作进行训练。

paragraphs.en: We measure how often pivot detection finds the oracle-labeled pivotal turns on ALFWorld. To this end, we run each training teacher on ALFWorld rollouts of the student that it trains, i.e., Qwen3-30B-A3B on Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3.5-122B-A10B on Qwen3-8B ( Section 4.1 ). As in Appendix A , we keep the failed trajectories that contain an oracle-labeled pivotal turn. Each teacher uses the same prompt, parsing, and decoding configuration as in training ( Section D.4 ). It therefore receives the full trajectory and its outcome, may choose among all turns, and selects up to m = 5 m=5 candidate turns. We draw 5 5 samples per trajectory and score only the teacher-detected pivotal turns, i.e., the candidate turns whose gold action disagrees with the student’s committed action. A sample is correct when at least one of these turns lies within one turn of the first oracle-labeled pivotal turn, and a reply that cannot be parsed counts as incorrect. We average correctness over the samples of each trajectory and then over trajectories. The random baseline selects as many turns as the sample’s teacher-detected pivotal turns, uniformly at random without replacement, and applies the same criterion. Its value therefore differs between the two teachers, which are evaluated on different trajectories and detect different numbers of pivotal turns. Both teachers agree with the oracle at least twice as often as the random baseline ( Table S.1 ). In Section 3.2 , we say that at least one teacher-detected pivotal turn falls within one turn of the oracle-labeled pivotal turn when a sample is correct in this sense, and we report the mean accuracy of the two teachers, 77.8 % 77.8\% .
paragraphs.zh: 我们衡量枢轴检测在 ALFWorld 中有多频繁地找到由神谕标注的枢轴转折点。 为此，我们在学生模型在 ALFWorld 中的运行轨迹上运行每个训练教师模型，即 Qwen3-30B-A3B 在 Qwen3-1.7B 上运行，Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 在 Qwen3-8B 上运行（第 4.1 节）。 与附录 A 中一样，我们保留包含神谕标注的枢轴转折点的失败轨迹。 每个教师模型都使用与训练时相同的提示、解析和解码配置（第 D.4 节）。 因此，它会接收完整的轨迹及其结果，可以在所有转折点中进行选择，并最多选择 m = 5 个候选转折点。 我们为每条轨迹抽取 5 个样本，并且仅对教师模型检测到的枢轴转折点进行评分，即其黄金动作与学生模型已执行的动作不一致的候选转折点。 当这些转折点中至少有一个位于第一个神谕标注的枢轴转折点前后一个转折点范围内时，该样本即为正确；而无法解析的回复则被视为不正确。 我们对每条轨迹的样本计算正确性的平均值，然后再对多条轨迹取平均。 随机基线模型会选择与样本中教师模型检测到的枢轴转折点数量相同、均匀随机且无重复的转折点，并应用相同的评判标准。 因此，其数值在两个教师模型之间存在差异，因为它们在不同的轨迹上进行评估，并且检测到的枢轴转折点数量不同。 两个教师模型与神谕一致的次数至少是随机基线模型的两倍（表 S.1）。 在第 3.2 节中，当样本在此意义上正确时，我们表示至少有一个教师模型检测到的枢轴转折点位于神谕标注的枢轴转折点前后一个转折点范围内，并报告两个教师模型的平均准确率，为 77.8%。

paragraphs.en: A generated recovery response is discarded if it matches any of a family of leakage patterns covering acknowledgments of a hint, suggestion, or provided approach. Training sequences are rebuilt from the unprivileged observation, and an assertion rejects any training prompt containing a privileged marker. As a result, hinted text can never enter the training prompt.
paragraphs.zh: 如果生成的恢复响应与任何泄露模式家族相匹配，包括对提示、建议或所提供方法的确认，该响应将被丢弃。 训练序列会从无权观察信息中重新构建，而断言机制会拒绝任何包含特权标记的训练提示。 因此，带有提示的文本永远无法进入训练提示。

paragraphs.en: Before taking recovery turns, multi-turn recovery replays the recorded action prefix in a pooled copy of the environment and verifies that the reached observation matches the recorded one exactly. A mismatch aborts the recovery. For k ≥ 2 k\geq 2 , the recovery context c ~ t + k \tilde{c}_{t+k} is reached by executing act ⁡ ( y rec ) \operatorname{act}(y_{\text{rec}}) of the previous recovery turn in this replayed environment rather than recorded in the original trajectory. The teacher is then queried again at c ~ t + k \tilde{c}_{t+k} for the next recovery action a t + k ∗ a^{*}_{t+k} . Each recovery turn adds one training sequence with its own loss ℒ t , k rec \mathcal{L}^{\mathrm{rec}}_{t,k} . Beyond this check, at most 64 64 recoveries are processed per training step, which bounds the time that recovery rollouts add to each step.
paragraphs.zh: 在执行恢复回合之前，多回合恢复机制会在环境的池化副本中重播记录下来的动作前缀，并验证所达到的观察结果是否与记录的结果完全一致。 如果出现不匹配，恢复过程将被中止。 对于 k ≥ 2，恢复上下文 c ~ t + k \tilde{c}_{t+k} 是通过在此重播环境中执行上一恢复回合的 act ⁡ ( y rec ) \operatorname{act}(y_{\text{rec}}) 得到的，而不是从原始轨迹中记录下来的。 随后，会在 c ~ t + k \tilde{c}_{t+k} 处再次向教师模型查询下一个恢复动作 a t + k ∗ a^{*}_{t+k}。 每个恢复回合都会添加一条训练序列，并带有其自身的损失 ℒ t , k rec \mathcal{L}^{\mathrm{rec}}_{t,k}。 除了这项检查之外，每个训练步骤最多处理 64 次恢复，从而限制了恢复展开在每个步骤中增加的时间。

paragraphs.en: The distillation terms of Eq. 3 enter the PPO update as per-token advantages built from the distillation advantage A ℓ distill A^{\mathrm{distill}}_{\ell} of Eq. 4 ,
paragraphs.zh: 公式 3 中的蒸馏项以基于公式 4 的蒸馏优势 A ℓ distill A^{\mathrm{distill}}_{\ell} 构建的逐词优势形式进入 PPO 更新，

paragraphs.en: where ℓ \ell indexes the tokens of the scored sequence and the clip bound δ \delta caps the distillation advantage on any single token. For prevention, the distillation advantage is evaluated at the pivotal context c t c_{t} with the gold action a t ∗ a^{*}_{t} and applied to the recorded response y t y_{t} . Positive values increase the weight of tokens preferred by the hinted view, and negative values decrease the weight of tokens that it disfavors, so the update shifts the student’s response toward the gold action. We keep the preventive weight w prev w_{\text{prev}} small ( Table S.3 ), since recovery distillation provides the main signal after a pivotal mistake. For recovery, the distillation advantage is evaluated at the recovery context c ~ t + k \tilde{c}_{t+k} with the recovery action a t + k ∗ a^{*}_{t+k} and applied to y rec y_{\text{rec}} . Unlike Eq. 1 , the recovery loss of Eq. 2 takes its expectation under the frozen self-teacher, and gradients again flow only through π θ \pi_{\theta} . The hint enters only this frozen target, while the trained response is conditioned on the unprivileged context c ~ t + k \tilde{c}_{t+k} . Relative to standard on-policy self-distillation [ 9 ] , the privileged view is the hint that names the gold action, and the preventive term applies only at the pivotal turns rather than on every response. paragraphs.en: This appendix proves Proposition 1 of Section 3.4 , states and proves two further propositions, and records a surrogate characterization of the recovery update. Parts (ii) and (iii) of Proposition 1 follow the standard contrast between reverse and forward KL [ 11 , 12 ] , and what is specific to PivotOPD is that recovery distillation applies the forward update at the states that the student’s own mistakes create. We analyze the committed action at a single recovery turn as one categorical decision, which is the standard abstraction for token-level updates. paragraphs.en: Lemma 1 holds for any hint, including the recorded hints of Section E.3 . It shows that the divergence from the self-teacher stays large whenever the self-teacher places substantial probability on an action that the student almost never takes, and that it can fall only when the student raises the probability of that action.
paragraphs.zh: 引理 1 对任何提示都成立，包括 E.3 节中记录的提示。 这表明，只要自教师对某个学生几乎从不采取的动作赋予了较大的概率，那么与自教师的差异就会保持较大；而只有当学生提高该动作的概率时，这种差异才会减小。

paragraphs.en: Suppose that completing the task after the pivotal turn requires taking a specific action at each of d d successive turns, and that the plain policy places mass at most ε < 1 \varepsilon<1 on each required action along this chain. After K < d K<d enforced recovery turns, the plain policy completes the remaining chain with probability at most ε d − K \varepsilon^{\,d-K} .
paragraphs.zh: 假设在关键转折点之后完成该任务，需要在连续 d 个回合中每一步都采取特定行动，而普通策略在这条链路上每个必要行动上的概率质量最多为 ε < 1。 经过 K < d 个强制恢复回合后，普通策略完成剩余链路的概率最多为 ε^{d-K}。

paragraphs.en: Proposition 3 guides the recovery budget, since K K should grow with the depth d d of the required chain. On ALFWorld, K = 2 K=2 also matches the two guided turns after the pivotal mistake that restore success in the replay of Figure 1 b.

paragraphs.en: Three remarks connect the analysis to the implementation. First, the acceptance filters of Section 3.3 replace the sampling distribution q q by its conditional on the accepted event while leaving the coefficients unchanged. The formulas above thus hold with q ⁡ ( a ) q(a) read as the accepted mass, and the expected update on the recovery action stays proportional to the mass that the filtered self-teacher places on it. Second, all statements concern the recovery context c ~ t + k \tilde{c}_{t+k} , which follows the student’s own mistake, and the student is trained without the hint. Supervised fine-tuning enforces teacher actions at the states that the teacher visits, whereas recovery distillation enforces the recovery action at the state produced by the student’s own mistake with a single hinted generation. Recovery therefore avoids the compounding mismatch of imitation at the states that only an expert visits [ 14 ] . Third, Propositions 2 and 1 make the division of labor in PivotOPD precise. Preventive distillation tempers the student where it already places mass, and recovery distillation plants mass exactly on the modes that the student has starved, at the turns that its mistakes produce.
paragraphs.zh: 有三点说明将分析与实施联系起来。 首先，第 3.3 节中的接受滤波器用其在接受事件上的条件分布替换了采样分布 q q，同时保持系数不变。 因此，上述公式成立，其中 q ⁡ ( a ) q(a) 应理解为已接受的质量，而恢复行动的期望更新仍与过滤后的自教师分配给该行动的质量成正比。 其次，所有陈述都涉及恢复上下文 c ~ t + k \tilde{c}_{t+k}，该上下文遵循学生自身的错误，并且学生在训练时没有提示。 有监督的微调在教师访问的状态上强制执行教师的行动，而恢复蒸馏则在由学生自身错误产生的状态上，通过单次提示生成来强制执行恢复行动。 因此，恢复方法避免了仅在专家访问的状态上模仿所导致的累积失配问题 [ 14 ]。 第三，命题 2 和命题 1 明确了 PivotOPD 中的分工。 预防性蒸馏在学生已有质量分配的地方对其进行调整，而恢复蒸馏则精确地在学生因缺乏质量而忽视的模式上、在其错误所导致的转折点上植入质量。

paragraphs.en: All methods share one on-policy training stack built on verl and train on H100 nodes. Training uses the standard ALFWorld training tasks, the WebShop instructions outside the held-out split, and the Search-R1 training split of Natural Questions and HotpotQA ( 169,615 169{,}615 questions). The student is served by vLLM for rollouts (tensor parallel 1 1 , thinking disabled) and updated with FSDP. Rollouts sample at temperature 1.0 1.0 during training and 0.4 0.4 at validation. Optimization uses token-mean loss aggregation, gradient clipping 1.0 1.0 , a low-variance KL loss, and discount γ = 0.95 \gamma=0.95 . Teachers are served as vLLM endpoints with a 32 32 K context window, with tensor parallel 2 2 for Qwen3-30B-A3B and 8 8 for Qwen3.5-122B-A10B. Teacher calls use the served model’s default sampling configuration. Table S.2 lists the per-benchmark hyperparameters, and Table S.3 lists the PivotOPD configuration. The recovery weight w rec w_{\text{rec}} is selected per benchmark with a halving sweep on validation performance, and on Search-based QA, the sweep selects a smaller weight for the 8B student. The recovery budget K K and the weight w rec w_{\text{rec}} interact, since each additional recovery turn adds one more distilled sequence per pivotal turn and thereby multiplies the total recovery signal. Deeper recovery therefore calls for a proportionally smaller weight, and on WebShop, K = 2 K=2 requires a quarter of the K = 1 K=1 weight to remain stable. Baselines receive the same tuning budget.
paragraphs.zh: 所有方法都共享一个基于 verl 的在线策略训练栈，并在 H100 节点上进行训练。 训练使用了标准的 ALFWorld 训练任务、预留集之外的 WebShop 指令，以及 Natural Questions 和 HotpotQA 的 Search-R1 训练子集（169,615 个问题）。 学生模型由 vLLM 提供服务以执行推理（张量并行 1，禁用思考），并通过 FSDP 进行更新。 推理过程中，训练阶段的采样温度为 1.0，验证阶段的采样温度为 0.4。 优化过程使用了令牌均值损失聚合、梯度裁剪值 1.0、低方差 KL 损失以及折扣因子 γ = 0.95。 教师模型作为 vLLM 端点提供服务，上下文窗口为 32K；其中 Qwen3-30B-A3B 的张量并行度为 2，Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 的张量并行度为 8。 教师模型的调用使用所提供服务模型默认的采样配置。 表 S.2 列出了各基准测试的超参数，表 S.3 列出了 PivotOPD 的配置。 恢复权重 w_{\text{rec}} 按基准测试分别选择，通过在验证性能上进行二分搜索确定；在基于搜索的 QA 任务中，该搜索为 8B 学生模型选择了较小的权重。 恢复预算 K 和恢复权重 w_{\text{rec}} 之间存在相互作用，因为每次额外的恢复步骤都会在每个关键步骤中添加一个蒸馏序列，从而成倍增加总恢复信号。 因此，更深层的恢复需要比例上更小的权重；在 WebShop 任务中，当 K = 2 时，为保持稳定所需的权重仅为 K = 1 时的四分之一。 基线模型也获得了相同的调优预算。

sents.en: Table S.2 lists the per-benchmark hyperparameters, and Table S.3 lists the PivotOPD configuration.
sents.zh: 表 S.2 列出了各基准测试的超参数，表 S.3 列出了 PivotOPD 的配置。

sents.en: The recovery weight w rec w_{\text{rec}} is selected per benchmark with a halving sweep on validation performance, and on Search-based QA, the sweep selects a smaller weight for the 8B student.
sents.zh: 恢复权重 w_{\text{rec}} 按基准测试分别选择，通过在验证性能上进行二分搜索确定；在基于搜索的 QA 任务中，该搜索为 8B 学生模型选择了较小的权重。

sents.en: The recovery budget K K and the weight w rec w_{\text{rec}} interact, since each additional recovery turn adds one more distilled sequence per pivotal turn and thereby multiplies the total recovery signal.
sents.zh: 恢复预算 K 和恢复权重 w_{\text{rec}} 之间存在相互作用，因为每次额外的恢复步骤都会在每个关键步骤中添加一个蒸馏序列，从而成倍增加总恢复信号。

sents.en: Deeper recovery therefore calls for a proportionally smaller weight, and on WebShop, K = 2 K=2 requires a quarter of the K = 1 K=1 weight to remain stable.
sents.zh: 因此，更深层的恢复需要比例上更小的权重；在 WebShop 任务中，当 K = 2 时，为保持稳定所需的权重仅为 K = 1 时的四分之一。

sents.en: Baselines receive the same tuning budget.
sents.zh: 基线模型也获得了相同的调优预算。

paragraphs.en: For every method and benchmark, we train for 160 160 steps, select the best checkpoint on a validation set, and evaluate the selected checkpoint on a held-out test set. Every experiment is run with three random seeds, and all reported results are averages over them. Validation and test rollouts sample at temperature 0.4 0.4 and are capped at 30 30 turns on ALFWorld, 15 15 on WebShop, and 4 4 on Search-based QA.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每种方法和基准测试，我们都会训练 160 步，在验证集上选择最佳检查点，并在预留的测试集上评估所选的检查点。 每次实验都使用三个随机种子运行，所有报告的结果都是这些种子的平均值。 在验证和测试过程中，采样温度为 0.4，并且在 ALFWorld 上最多执行 30 轮，在 WebShop 上最多执行 15 轮，在基于搜索的问答任务中最多执行 4 轮。

paragraphs.en: Checkpoint selection uses 128 128 validation tasks evaluated every 10 10 training steps at temperature 0.4 0.4 . The selected checkpoint is evaluated on all 274 274 held-out tasks, i.e., the 140 140 tasks of the valid_seen split and the 134 134 tasks of the valid_unseen split. The reported average is the unweighted mean of the six task-type success rates.
paragraphs.zh: 检查点选择使用 128 个验证任务，每 10 个训练步骤在温度为 0.4 时进行一次评估。 选定的检查点会在所有 274 个预留任务上进行评估，即 valid_seen 分集中的 140 个任务和 valid_unseen 分集中的 134 个任务。 所报告的平均值是六种任务类型成功率在未加权情况下的均值。

sents.zh: 检查点选择使用 128 个验证任务，每 10 个训练步骤在温度为 0.4 时进行一次评估。

paragraphs.en: The benchmark provides 6,910 6{,}910 instructions over 1,000 1{,}000 products. The first 500 500 instructions are held out, and the rest are used for training. Checkpoint selection uses a 128 128 -instruction validation set evaluated every 10 10 steps. The selected checkpoint runs on each of the 500 500 held-out instructions. The success rate counts strictly completed purchases, and the score is the dense task score. Product retrieval uses BM25 ( k 1 = 1.5 k_{1}=1.5 , b = 0.75 b=0.75 ) over the title, description, category, bullet-point, and option fields at both training and evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 该基准测试为 1,000 个产品提供了 6,910 条指令。 前 500 条指令被预留，其余的则用于训练。 检查点选择使用一个包含 128 条指令的验证集，每 10 步评估一次。 选定的检查点在预留的 500 条指令上分别运行。 成功率严格统计成功完成的购买次数，得分则为密集任务得分。 产品检索在训练和评估阶段均基于标题、描述、类别、要点和选项字段使用 BM25（k₁ = 1.5，b = 0.75）。

paragraphs.en: Checkpoint selection uses a mixed validation set of 256 256 questions evaluated every 10 10 steps. The per-dataset accuracies use a balanced evaluation set of 725 725 questions, drawn with a fixed seed from a held-out pool of 51,713 51{,}713 questions, with 100 100 per dataset plus all 125 125 Bamboogle questions. The metric is strict exact match, and the reported average is the unweighted mean of the seven per-dataset accuracies. The agent queries an E5 retriever [ 42 ] over the 2018 Wikipedia corpus and receives the top- 3 3 passages per call, identically at training and evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 检查点选择使用一个混合验证集，包含 256 个问题，每 10 步评估一次。 每个数据集的准确率使用一个平衡的评估集，包含 725 个问题，这些问题是从一个保留的 51,713 个问题的池中通过固定种子抽取的，每个数据集包含 100 个问题以及全部 125 个 Bamboogle 问题。 该指标为严格的精确匹配，所报告的平均值是七个数据集准确率的不加权平均。 智能体通过 E5 检索器 [42] 查询 2018 年维基百科语料库，每次调用接收前 3 个相关段落，训练和评估阶段均保持一致。

sents.zh: 检查点选择使用一个混合验证集，包含 256 个问题，每 10 步评估一次。

sents.zh: 智能体通过 E5 检索器 [42] 查询 2018 年维基百科语料库，每次调用接收前 3 个相关段落，训练和评估阶段均保持一致。

paragraphs.en: GRPO [ 20 ] optimizes a group-relative advantage from outcome rewards.
paragraphs.zh: GRPO [ 20 ] 优化来自结果奖励的群体相对优势。

paragraphs.en: OPSD [ 9 ] distills a privileged self-teacher on the student’s own responses.
paragraphs.zh: OPSD [ 9 ] 基于学生自身的回答，提炼出一个具有特权的学生自我教师。

paragraphs.en: RLSD [ 36 ] combines the two through teacher-guided advantage rescaling.
paragraphs.zh: RLSD [ 36 ] 通过教师引导的优势重缩放将两者结合。

paragraphs.en: SDAR [ 37 ] combines the two through a gated distillation loss.
paragraphs.zh: SDAR [ 37 ] 通过门控蒸馏损失将两者结合。

paragraphs.en: TurnOPD [ 10 ] makes the distillation signal turn-aware.
paragraphs.zh: TurnOPD [ 10 ] 使蒸馏信号具备转向感知能力。

paragraphs.en: TCOD [ 15 ] expands the distilled trajectory depth from short to long with a curriculum.
paragraphs.zh: TCOD [ 15 ] 通过课程学习机制，将蒸馏轨迹的深度从短扩展到长。

paragraphs.en: SOD [ 17 ] reweights turn-level divergences.
paragraphs.zh: SOD [ 17 ] 对回合级分歧进行重新加权。

paragraphs.en: StepOPSD [ 18 ] weights turns by hindsight from successful trajectories in the same rollout group.
paragraphs.zh: StepOPSD [ 18 ] 通过回顾同一展开组中成功轨迹来调整智能体的动作。

paragraphs.en: AgentOPSD [ 38 ] converts outcome rewards into turn-level credit through recursive self-distillation.
paragraphs.zh: AgentOPSD [ 38 ] 通过递归自蒸馏将结果奖励转化为回合级信用。

paragraphs.en: Skill-GRPO , the skill-augmented GRPO baseline of OPID [ 23 ] , injects retrieved skills into training prompts.
paragraphs.zh: Skill-GRPO，即 OPID [23] 中引入技能的 GRPO 基线模型，将检索到的技能注入训练提示中。

paragraphs.en: Skill-SD [ 39 ] conditions the self-teacher on retrieved skills.
paragraphs.zh: Skill-SD [ 39 ] 将自教师与检索到的技能进行条件约束。

paragraphs.en: OPID distills trajectory- and turn-level skills extracted from the student’s own rollouts.
paragraphs.zh: OPID 提炼出从学生自身展开策略中提取的轨迹级和回合级技能。

paragraphs.en: PivotRL [ 22 ] concentrates updates on pivotal turns identified from rollout outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: PivotRL [ 22 ] 将更新集中在通过展开结果识别出的关键转折点上。

paragraphs.en: All baselines share the benchmarks, data, and optimization of Section D.1 , and GRPO uses the same advantage estimator with no teacher signal. The skill-based baselines (OPSD, Skill-SD, RLSD, SDAR, and Skill-GRPO) draw on a per-benchmark skill bank distilled from the student’s own earlier rollouts, with 47 47 entries for ALFWorld, 200 200 for WebShop, and 75 75 for Search-based QA. Skill-GRPO injects the top- 6 6 retrieved skills into training prompts only. StepOPSD instead uses the first successful trajectory from the same rollout group as hindsight guidance. The auxiliary distillation coefficient is 1.0 1.0 for OPSD, 0.001 0.001 for Skill-SD, and 0.01 0.01 for SDAR. RLSD and StepOPSD reshape advantages and carry no auxiliary loss.
paragraphs.zh: 所有基线方法均共享 D.1 节中的基准测试、数据和优化策略，而 GRPO 则使用相同的优势估计器，且无教师信号。 基于技能的基线方法（OPSD、Skill-SD、RLSD、SDAR 和 Skill-GRPO）利用每个基准测试对应的技能库，该技能库从学生智能体早期的自身执行轨迹中蒸馏而来：ALFWorld 包含 47 个条目，WebShop 包含 200 个条目，Search-based QA 包含 75 个条目。 Skill-GRPO 仅将检索到的前 6 个技能注入训练提示中。 StepOPSD 则使用同一执行轨迹组中的首个成功轨迹作为事后指导。 辅助蒸馏系数为：OPSD 设为 1.0，Skill-SD 设为 0.001，SDAR 设为 0.01。 RLSD 和 StepOPSD 会重塑优势值，且不引入任何辅助损失。

sents.zh: 辅助蒸馏系数为：OPSD 设为 1.0，Skill-SD 设为 0.001，SDAR 设为 0.01。

paragraphs.en: Two implementation choices differ from the original papers. OPSD’s full-vocabulary divergence is approximated with a sampled-token reverse-KL surrogate, and the RLSD and StepOPSD self-teachers re-synchronize every training step instead of every ten.
paragraphs.zh: 两种实现方式与原始论文有所不同。 OPSD 的全词汇发散性通过采样标记的反 KL 代理进行近似，而 RLSD 和 StepOPSD 的自教师则在每个训练步骤中重新同步，而不是每十步一次。

paragraphs.en: At every turn, the student receives one prompt containing the task, the current observation, and the admissible actions. It responds with reasoning in <think> tags followed by one action in <action> tags. The example below is the first turn of a held-out ALFWorld task, with the location and action lists abbreviated; WebShop and Search-based QA use the same structure with their own action formats.
paragraphs.zh: 在每个回合中，学生都会收到一个提示，其中包含任务、当前观察结果和允许执行的动作。 它会以 <think> 标签内的推理过程进行回应，随后在 <action> 标签内给出一个动作。 下面的示例是一个保留的 ALFWorld 任务中的第一个回合，其中位置和动作列表已简化；WebShop 和基于搜索的 QA 也使用相同结构，但各自采用不同的动作格式。

sents.en: At every turn, the student receives one prompt containing the task, the current observation, and the admissible actions.
sents.zh: 在每个回合中，学生都会收到一个提示，其中包含任务、当前观察结果和允许执行的动作。

sents.en: It responds with reasoning in <think> tags followed by one action in <action> tags.
sents.zh: 它会以 <think> 标签内的推理过程进行回应，随后在 <action> 标签内给出一个动作。

sents.en: The example below is the first turn of a held-out ALFWorld task, with the location and action lists abbreviated; WebShop and Search-based QA use the same structure with their own action formats.
sents.zh: 下面的示例是一个保留的 ALFWorld 任务中的第一个回合，其中位置和动作列表已简化；WebShop 和基于搜索的 QA 也使用相同结构，但各自采用不同的动作格式。

paragraphs.en: For each trajectory, the teacher receives the task, the outcome, the indices of all turns as eligible turns , and the formatted trajectory, and it returns the report of Appendix B in one reply. The template calls the eligible turns candidate step indices, and the turns that the teacher selects among them are the candidate turns of Section 3.2 . The JSON fields episode_summary , episode_lesson , and step_lessons carry the trajectory summary, the trajectory-level lesson, and the per-turn lessons, and one <correct_action> block per chosen turn names the gold action. The action-format example is benchmark-specific, shown here for ALFWorld. On WebShop and Search-based QA, the template appends short environment rules that force each recommended action to be a literal executable action, such as clicking every required option value before a purchase or adding new disambiguating terms to a search query.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每条轨迹，教师智能体接收任务、结果、所有有效回合的索引以及格式化的轨迹，并在一次回复中返回附录 B 的报告。 模板调用有效回合的候选步骤索引，而教师智能体从中选择的回合即为第 3.2 节的候选回合。 JSON 字段 episode_summary、episode_lesson 和 step_lessons 分别包含轨迹摘要、轨迹级课程以及各回合的课程，每个被选中的回合中都会通过一个 <correct_action> 块指出标准动作的名称。 动作格式的具体示例因基准测试而异，此处以 ALFWorld 为例展示。 在 WebShop 和基于搜索的问答任务中，模板会附加简短的环境规则，强制每个推荐动作必须是可直接执行的具体操作，例如在购买前点击所有必需的选项值，或在搜索查询中添加新的消歧义词项。

sents.en: On WebShop and Search-based QA, the template appends short environment rules that force each recommended action to be a literal executable action, such as clicking every required option value before a purchase or adding new disambiguating terms to a search query.
sents.zh: 在 WebShop 和基于搜索的问答任务中，模板会附加简短的环境规则，强制每个推荐动作必须是可直接执行的具体操作，例如在购买前点击所有必需的选项值，或在搜索查询中添加新的消歧义词项。

paragraphs.en: At each recovery turn after a pivotal mistake, the teacher receives the student-facing observation of the current post-mistake state and names the single best next action, which becomes the recovery action of Section 3 . The situation block already contains the task, the recent history, and the admissible actions, so the teacher sees exactly what the student sees.
paragraphs.zh: 在每次关键性失误后的恢复回合中，教师会接收到面向学生的当前失误后状态观察信息，并指定唯一最佳后续行动，该行动即成为第 3 节所述的恢复行动。 情境模块已包含任务、近期历史以及允许采取的行动，因此教师能看到与学生完全相同的信息。

paragraphs.en: We train on a curated software-engineering curriculum of root-cause bug-fix instances augmented with single-file SWE-rebench tasks, decontaminated against SWE-Bench Verified by removing all overlapping repositories and issues. The agent operates an OpenHands-style function-calling scaffold whose tools are repository exploration, file editing, shell execution, and patch submission, with a 100 100 -turn and 3,600 3{,}600 -second budget per episode and a 196 196 K-token context. Each training step rolls out G = 16 G=16 trajectories for each of 32 32 instances at temperature 0.6 0.6 , and the teacher is served as a vLLM endpoint. Because SWE-Bench episodes are long and containerized, we adapt the configuration as follows. For each task group with failures, the teacher audits one failed trajectory at its final committed action ( m = 1 m=1 ) and names a gold action. The hint uses the same template as in Section D.4 . Unlike on the other benchmarks, the hinted distribution comes from Nemotron-3-Super rather than from a privileged self-teacher, and it enters the unclipped preventive advantage A ℓ prev A^{\mathrm{prev}}_{\ell} of Eq. 5 at weight w prev = 0.1 w_{\text{prev}}=0.1 . The recovery budget is K = 0 K=0 , since the audited turn is the final committed action, after which the recorded trajectory contains no turn at which to apply recovery distillation. Extending pivot detection to earlier turns, where recovery distillation would apply, is left to future work. The standard OPD baseline is on-policy distillation from the same Nemotron-3-Super teacher, which distills its token-level distribution on the student’s own trajectories [ 11 ] , and PivotOPD adds preventive distillation to this objective. Both methods share data, scaffold, and tuning budget, and they train at a constant learning rate of 3 × 10 − 6 3\times 10^{-6} .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在一个精心挑选的软件工程课程上进行训练，该课程包含根本原因故障修复实例，并辅以单文件 SWE-rebench 任务；同时通过移除所有重叠的仓库和议题，消除了与 SWE-Bench Verified 的污染。 该智能体运行一个 OpenHands 风格的函数调用框架，其工具包括仓库探索、文件编辑、壳命令执行和补丁提交；每轮次预算为 100 个回合和 3,600 秒，上下文长度为 196 K-token。 每个训练步骤以 0.6 的温度为 32 个实例中的每个实例生成 G = 16 条轨迹，并将教师模型作为 vLLM 端点提供服务。 由于 SWE-Bench 的轮次较长且容器化，我们对配置进行了如下调整。 对于每个存在失败的任务组，教师模型会审计一条失败轨迹在其最终已提交的行动（m = 1）处，并指定一个黄金行动。 提示使用了与 D.4 节相同的模板。 与其他基准测试不同，提示的分布来自 Nemotron-3-Super，而非特权自教师模型；它在公式 5 中未裁剪的预防性优势 A^{\mathrm{prev}}_{\ell} 处引入权重 w_{\text{prev}}=0.1。 恢复预算为 K = 0，因为被审计的回合是最终已提交的行动，在此之后记录轨迹中不再存在可用于应用恢复蒸馏的回合。 将枢轴检测扩展到更早的回合（即恢复蒸馏可应用的阶段）留待未来工作完成。 标准的 OPD 基线方法是从相同的 Nemotron-3-Super 教师模型进行策略内蒸馏，该蒸馏基于学生模型自身轨迹上的词元级分布 [11]；而 PivotOPD 在此目标中增加了预防性蒸馏。 两种方法共享数据、框架和调优预算，并以恒定的学习率 3 × 10^{-6} 进行训练。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate on the 500 500 tasks of SWE-Bench Verified using the OpenCode agent scaffold within the NeMo Gym harness. Each task is run once under each of 3 3 evaluation seeds in an isolated per-task sandbox, and the agent queries our model through a disaggregated vLLM deployment with separate prefill and decode workers. We sample at temperature 1.0 1.0 with top- p p of 0.95 0.95 and report the resolve rate, i.e., the percentage of tasks whose submitted patch passes the associated unit tests, averaged over the three evaluation seeds.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 NeMo Gym 框架内使用 OpenCode 智能体架构，在 SWE-Bench Verified 的 500 个任务上进行评估。 每个任务在 3 个评估种子下各运行一次，且在一个按任务隔离的沙盒中执行；智能体通过一个解耦的 vLLM 部署查询我们的模型，该部署包含独立的预填充和解码工作器。 我们在温度 1.0 的条件下进行采样，设置 top-p 为 0.95，并报告解决率，即已提交补丁通过相关单元测试的任务百分比，该结果基于三个评估种子计算平均值。

paragraphs.en: Table S.4 reports the component ablations of Section 5 on every ALFWorld task type. The preventive-only variant sets K = 0 K=0 and raises the preventive weight from w prev = 0.001 w_{\text{prev}}=0.001 ( Table S.3 ) to 0.1 0.1 . Without recovery distillation, the smaller weight would add only a small pivot-specific signal to the group-relative RL advantage. The larger weight therefore makes preventive only a stronger reference, so its comparison with PivotOPD tests whether recovery distillation adds to a substantial preventive signal rather than to group-based RL alone. The variant with random pivotal turns injects the same hints as PivotOPD at randomly chosen turns under a matched budget. Relative to preventive only, removing gold actions from the hints lowers the success rate the most on Pick2, by 9.3 % 9.3\% . This gap suggests that naming the action is necessary on task types whose decisions cannot be inferred from the observations alone.
paragraphs.zh: 表 S.4 报告了第 5 节中每个 ALFWorld 任务类型的组件消融分析结果。 仅预防变体将 K 设为 0（K=0），并将预防权重从 w_prev = 0.001（w_{\text{prev}}=0.001，见表 S.3）提升至 0.1。 如果没有恢复蒸馏，较小的权重只会向组相对强化学习优势中添加微弱的特定于枢轴的信号。 因此，较大的权重使仅预防策略成为一个更强的参考，因此将其与 PivotOPD 进行比较，可以检验恢复蒸馏所增加的是显著的预防信号，而非仅基于组的强化学习信号。 具有随机枢轴回合的变体在匹配的预算下，会在随机选择的回合中注入与 PivotOPD 相同的提示。 相对于仅预防策略，从提示中移除黄金动作会使成功率的下降幅度最大，尤其是在 Pick2 任务上，下降了 9.3%（9.3\%）。 这一差距表明，在那些无法仅通过观察推断出决策的任务类型中，明确命名动作是必要的。

paragraphs.en: Figure 6 presents the validation trends for the recovery-budget ablation in Section 5 , where K = 0 K=0 is the preventive-only variant. The choice of K K has a substantial effect on validation performance. On WebShop, the score at the end of training differs by up to 19.5 % 19.5\% across budgets. More recovery turns, however, do not always improve performance, and increasing the budget from K = 1 K=1 to K = 3 K=3 lowers this score by 7.8 % 7.8\% .
paragraphs.zh: 图6展示了第5节中恢复预算消融实验的验证趋势，其中 K = 0 是仅包含预防策略的变体。 K 的选择对验证性能有显著影响。 在 WebShop 数据集上，训练结束时不同预算下的得分差异最高可达 19.5%。 然而，更多的恢复步骤并不总能提升性能，将预算从 K = 1 增加到 K = 3 会使该得分下降 7.8%。

sents.en: More recovery turns, however, do not always improve performance, and increasing the budget from K = 1 K=1 to K = 3 K=3 lowers this score by 7.8 % 7.8\% .
sents.zh: 然而，更多的恢复步骤并不总能提升性能，将预算从 K = 1 增加到 K = 3 会使该得分下降 7.8%。

paragraphs.en: PivotOPD changes only training. At test time, the student acts without the teacher model, hints, or recovery, so PivotOPD adds no computation at inference. During training, preventive and recovery distillation add two computations to group-based RL. The first is the forward pass of the privileged self-teacher, which computes the distillation advantage of Eq. 4 . The second consists of the recovery rollouts , which query the teacher model for a recovery action and sample a recovery response at every recovery turn ( Algorithm 1 ). We do not include pivot detection, whose cost depends mainly on the choice of teacher model and how it is served.
paragraphs.zh: PivotOPD 仅改变训练过程。 在测试阶段，学生模型无需教师模型、提示或恢复机制即可行动，因此 PivotOPD 在推理阶段不会增加任何计算量。 在训练阶段，预防性蒸馏和恢复性蒸馏为基于组的强化学习增加了两项计算。 第一项是特权自教师的正向传播，用于计算公式 4 中的蒸馏优势。 第二项包括恢复过程：在每个恢复回合中，系统会向教师模型查询恢复动作，并采样恢复响应（算法 1）。 我们未包含枢轴检测，其成本主要取决于教师模型的选择及其服务方式。

sents.en: PivotOPD changes only training.
sents.zh: PivotOPD 仅改变训练过程。

sents.en: At test time, the student acts without the teacher model, hints, or recovery, so PivotOPD adds no computation at inference.
sents.zh: 在测试阶段，学生模型无需教师模型、提示或恢复机制即可行动，因此 PivotOPD 在推理阶段不会增加任何计算量。

sents.zh: 第一项是特权自教师的正向传播，用于计算公式 4 中的蒸馏优势。

sents.en: The second consists of the recovery rollouts , which query the teacher model for a recovery action and sample a recovery response at every recovery turn ( Algorithm 1 ).
sents.zh: 第二项包括恢复过程：在每个恢复回合中，系统会向教师模型查询恢复动作，并采样恢复响应（算法 1）。

sents.en: We do not include pivot detection, whose cost depends mainly on the choice of teacher model and how it is served.
sents.zh: 我们未包含枢轴检测，其成本主要取决于教师模型的选择及其服务方式。

paragraphs.en: We time both computations on ALFWorld with the Qwen3-1.7B student on one node of four H100 GPUs, where GRPO takes 367.3 367.3 seconds per training step ( Table S.5 ). The self-teacher forward pass is the same kind of computation that self-distillation baselines such as OPSD and RLSD perform. With K = 1 K=1 , recovery rollouts are inexpensive because the only recovery turn starts from the post-mistake state that the rollout has already reached, so it needs no environment replay. Each later recovery turn must instead be reached through environment replay ( Appendix B ), and the time of recovery rollouts grows by more than ten times from K = 1 K=1 to K = 2 K=2 . Among the three main benchmarks, only ALFWorld uses more than one recovery turn ( Table S.3 ). On WebShop, where K = 1 K=1 is the selected budget, recovery rollouts likewise add only 12.2 % 12.2\% to the time per training step of GRPO, measured with 16 16 GPUs per run over the first 41 41 training steps.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在包含四块 H100 GPU 的单节点上，使用 Qwen3-1.7B 学生模型对 ALFWorld 中的两种计算进行了计时，其中 GRPO 每个训练步骤需要 367.3 秒（表 S.5）。 自教师的前向传播与 OPSD 和 RLSD 等自蒸馏基线方法所执行的是同一种计算。 当 K = 1 时，恢复展开的成本较低，因为唯一的恢复回合从展开过程已经达到的错误后状态开始，因此无需环境重播。 相反，每个后续的恢复回合都必须通过环境重播来实现（附录 B），并且从 K = 1 到 K = 2 时，恢复展开的时间增长超过十倍。 在三个主要基准测试中，只有 ALFWorld 使用了超过一个恢复回合（表 S.3）。 在 WebShop 中，由于选择的预算是 K = 1，恢复展开同样仅使 GRPO 每个训练步骤的时间增加了 12.2%，该数据是在每次运行使用 16 块 GPU 并测量前 41 个训练步骤时得出的。
