paragraphs.en: This analysis examines whether trained policies can recover after a pivotal mistake has already been committed, complementing the motivating replay study in Appendix A .
paragraphs.zh: 本分析旨在探究：在关键性错误已经发生之后，训练好的智能体策略是否能够恢复，从而对附录A中提出的重播研究形成补充。

paragraphs.en: We use the same 72 72 pivotal mistakes identified by the environment’s symbolic oracle in Section 2 . These oracle-labeled pivotal mistakes are independent of the teacher-detected pivotal turns used in training, so this evaluation does not reward agreement with the teacher’s own labels. For each pivotal mistake, we replay the trajectory prefix up to and including the pivotal mistake in a fresh copy of the ALFWorld environment, verify that the reached state matches the recorded one, and let the policy continue on its own for the remainder of the 30 30 -turn budget. Each prefix is replayed 8 8 times per policy, giving 576 576 replays per policy.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用了第 2 节中环境符号化神谕所识别的相同 72 个关键性错误。 这些由神谕标注的关键性错误独立于训练中所使用的教师检测到的关键性转折点，因此该评估不会奖励与教师自身标签的一致性。 对于每个关键性错误，我们都会在 ALFWorld 环境的一个全新副本中重播轨迹前缀（包括该关键性错误），验证所达到的状态是否与记录的一致，然后让策略自行继续执行剩余的 30 轮预算。 每个前缀对每个策略都会重播 8 次，因此每个策略总共会进行 576 次重播。

paragraphs.en: We compare four policies. Base is the untrained Qwen3-8B model. Standard OPD is the best checkpoint of the OPSD run in Appendix A from a sweep over training steps. Preventive only is PivotOPD trained for 160 160 steps with recovery budget K = 0 K=0 , as in Section 5 . PivotOPD is the full method trained for 160 160 steps with K = 2 K=2 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们比较了四种策略。 Base 是未经训练的 Qwen3-8B 模型。 Standard OPD 是在附录 A 中通过遍历训练步数得到的 OPSD 运行的最佳检查点。 Preventive only 是 PivotOPD，在 160 个训练步数下以恢复预算 K = 0 进行训练，如第 5 节所述。 PivotOPD 是完整的方法，在 160 个训练步数下以 K = 2 进行训练。

paragraphs.en: A replay counts as recovered within x x turns when it completes the task and its continuation after the pivotal mistake uses at most x x turns. The curve at each value of x x is the per-mistake mean averaged over the 72 72 pivotal mistakes, so every pivotal mistake contributes equally regardless of how many of its replays succeed. Final recovery rates are 8.3 % 8.3\% (Base), 20.3 % 20.3\% (Standard OPD), 45.8 % 45.8\% (preventive only), and 72.7 % 72.7\% ( PivotOPD ).
paragraphs.zh: 当重播在 x x 步内完成任务，且其在关键错误后的后续步骤最多使用 x x 步时，该重播即被视为成功恢复。 每个 x x 值对应的曲线是每次错误的平均值，该平均值基于 72 个关键错误计算得出，因此无论每个关键错误有多少次重播成功，它们都同等贡献。 最终恢复率分别为：8.3 %（基础）、20.3 %（标准 OPD）、45.8 %（仅预防）和 72.7 %（PivotOPD）。

paragraphs.en: Because every policy replays the same 72 72 pivotal mistakes, we also compare each trained policy with the base model on each pivotal mistake separately. The recovery rate of a pivotal mistake is the fraction of its 8 8 replays that recover, and the sign of its difference from the rate of the base model marks the pivotal mistake as improved, worsened, or unchanged. Standard OPD improves the recovery rate on 20 20 of the 72 72 pivotal mistakes, worsens it on 4 4 , and leaves 48 48 unchanged. The preventive-only variant improves 47 47 , worsens 6 6 , and leaves 19 19 unchanged. PivotOPD improves 60 60 and worsens none, leaving 12 12 unchanged. These counts come from the same replays as the recovery curves, and they show that the higher recovery rate of PivotOPD extends across most pivotal mistakes rather than coming from a few of them.
paragraphs.zh: 由于每条策略都会重播相同的 72 个关键性错误，因此我们还对每条训练后的策略与基础模型在每个关键性错误上的表现分别进行比较。 某个关键性错误的恢复率是指在其 8 次重播中成功恢复的次数所占的比例，而该恢复率与基础模型恢复率之差的正负号则表明该关键性错误是得到改善、恶化还是保持不变。 标准 OPD 在 72 个关键性错误中的 20 个上提高了恢复率，在 4 个上使其恶化，另有 48 个保持不变。 仅预防型变体在 47 个关键性错误上有所改善，6 个上有所恶化，另有 19 个保持不变。 PivotOPD 在 60 个关键性错误上实现了改善，没有造成任何恶化，另有 12 个保持不变。 这些计数来自与恢复曲线相同的重播数据，它们表明 PivotOPD 更高的恢复率覆盖大多数关键性错误，而并非仅源于少数几个错误。

paragraphs.en: Figure 7 compares the Qwen3-8B checkpoints of the preventive-only variant ( K = 0 K=0 ) and a separate PivotOPD run with K = 1 K=1 at training steps 140 140 and 160 160 . Each pair of checkpoints scores the ALFWorld training rollouts of the preventive-only variant from a disjoint window of steps, i.e., steps 130 130 – 149 149 for the checkpoints at step 140 140 and steps 150 150 – 160 160 for those at step 160 160 . Both variants therefore score the same responses at the same turns, and every scored state is one that the preventive-only variant visits itself. For each turn, we compute the forward KL divergence from each policy’s privileged self-teacher to the policy over the full vocabulary and average it over the response tokens. The self-teacher receives the hints recorded with these rollouts, which include the trajectory-level lesson at every turn and the gold action at candidate turns. The preventive-only variant records no recovery actions, so this divergence uses the recorded hints rather than the recovery-action hint of Eq. 2 , and it serves as a proxy for the recovery loss rather than the loss itself ( Lemma 1 ). We align each trajectory at its first teacher-detected pivotal turn and exclude turn 0 0 . The analysis covers 600 600 trajectories, 351 351 of which contain a teacher-detected pivotal turn. The shaded bands show 95 % 95\% bootstrap confidence intervals clustered over trajectories ( 2,000 2{,}000 draws, seed 0 0 ). In Figure 7 , both students track their self-teachers closely before the pivotal mistake, and the divergence spikes at the pivotal turn, where the hint names the gold action.
paragraphs.zh: 图 7 比较了仅预防变体（K = 0）的 Qwen3-8B 检查点与 K = 1 的独立 PivotOPD 运行在训练步数 140 和 160 时的结果。 每对检查点均基于仅预防变体的 ALFWorld 训练展开，从互不重叠的步数窗口中评分：即步数 140 的检查点对应步数 130–149，而步数 160 的检查点对应步数 150–160。 因此，两种变体在相同回合对相同的响应进行评分，且所有被评分的状态均为仅预防变体自身会访问的状态。 对于每个回合，我们计算每种策略从其特权自教师到覆盖完整词汇表的策略的前向 KL 散度，并在响应词元上取平均值。 自教师接收与这些展开记录在一起的提示，包括每个回合的轨迹级教训以及候选回合的黄金动作。 仅预防变体未记录任何恢复动作，因此该散度使用已记录的提示而非公式 2 中的恢复动作提示，并作为恢复损失的代理指标，而非损失本身（引理 1）。 我们在每个轨迹的首个教师检测到的关键回合处进行对齐，并排除第 0 回合。 该分析涵盖了 600 条轨迹，其中 351 条包含教师检测到的关键回合。 阴影带显示了按轨迹聚类后的 95% 自助置信区间（2,000 次抽样，种子为 0）。 在图 7 中，两个学生在关键错误发生前都紧密跟随其自教师，而散度在关键回合处急剧上升，此时提示指出了黄金动作。

sents.en: Figure 7 compares the Qwen3-8B checkpoints of the preventive-only variant ( K = 0 K=0 ) and a separate PivotOPD run with K = 1 K=1 at training steps 140 140 and 160 160 .
sents.zh: 图 7 比较了仅预防变体（K = 0）的 Qwen3-8B 检查点与 K = 1 的独立 PivotOPD 运行在训练步数 140 和 160 时的结果。

sents.en: Both variants therefore score the same responses at the same turns, and every scored state is one that the preventive-only variant visits itself.
sents.zh: 因此，两种变体在相同回合对相同的响应进行评分，且所有被评分的状态均为仅预防变体自身会访问的状态。

sents.en: For each turn, we compute the forward KL divergence from each policy’s privileged self-teacher to the policy over the full vocabulary and average it over the response tokens.
sents.zh: 对于每个回合，我们计算每种策略从其特权自教师到覆盖完整词汇表的策略的前向 KL 散度，并在响应词元上取平均值。

sents.en: The self-teacher receives the hints recorded with these rollouts, which include the trajectory-level lesson at every turn and the gold action at candidate turns.

sents.en: The preventive-only variant records no recovery actions, so this divergence uses the recorded hints rather than the recovery-action hint of Eq. 2 , and it serves as a proxy for the recovery loss rather than the loss itself ( Lemma 1 ).

sents.zh: 我们在每个轨迹的首个教师检测到的关键回合处进行对齐，并排除第 0 回合。

paragraphs.en: Sequence-level knowledge distillation trains a student on outputs sampled from the teacher [ 25 , 43 ] . On-policy distillation instead supervises the student on its own samples, and prior work discusses which KL direction suits this setting. GKD compares forward and reverse KL on student-generated sequences [ 11 ] , and MiniLLM favors reverse KL so that the student does not overestimate regions where the teacher places little mass [ 12 , 13 ] . For multi-turn agents, recent methods reweight turns or schedule the distilled trajectory depth [ 10 , 15 , 17 , 18 , 38 ] , but they still distill only on student-sampled responses. PivotOPD chooses the direction by where the supervision is needed. Preventive distillation applies reverse KL to a response that the student has already sampled, while recovery distillation applies forward KL to self-teacher responses that the student rarely produces, in the spirit of sequence-level distillation.
paragraphs.zh: 序列级知识蒸馏通过从教师模型中采样的输出来训练学生模型 [ 25 , 43 ] 。 在策略蒸馏中，则基于学生模型自身的样本对其进行监督，而先前的研究探讨了哪种 KL 方向更适合这种设定。 GKD 对学生生成的序列进行了前向 KL 和反向 KL 的比较 [ 11 ] ，其中 MiniLLM 更倾向于使用反向 KL，以防止学生模型高估教师模型质量分布较少的区域 [ 12 , 13 ] 。 对于多轮智能体，近期的方法会对各轮次进行重新加权或调整蒸馏轨迹的深度 [ 10 , 15 , 17 , 18 , 38 ] ，但它们仍然仅基于学生模型采样的响应进行蒸馏。 PivotOPD 根据监督所需的位置来选择方向。 预防性蒸馏将反向 KL 应用于学生模型已经采样的响应，而恢复性蒸馏则遵循序列级蒸馏的思路，将前向 KL 应用于学生模型极少生成的自教师响应。

sents.en: Sequence-level knowledge distillation trains a student on outputs sampled from the teacher [ 25 , 43 ] .
sents.zh: 序列级知识蒸馏通过从教师模型中采样的输出来训练学生模型 [ 25 , 43 ] 。

sents.en: On-policy distillation instead supervises the student on its own samples, and prior work discusses which KL direction suits this setting.
sents.zh: 在策略蒸馏中，则基于学生模型自身的样本对其进行监督，而先前的研究探讨了哪种 KL 方向更适合这种设定。

sents.en: GKD compares forward and reverse KL on student-generated sequences [ 11 ] , and MiniLLM favors reverse KL so that the student does not overestimate regions where the teacher places little mass [ 12 , 13 ] .
sents.zh: GKD 对学生生成的序列进行了前向 KL 和反向 KL 的比较 [ 11 ] ，其中 MiniLLM 更倾向于使用反向 KL，以防止学生模型高估教师模型质量分布较少的区域 [ 12 , 13 ] 。

sents.en: For multi-turn agents, recent methods reweight turns or schedule the distilled trajectory depth [ 10 , 15 , 17 , 18 , 38 ] , but they still distill only on student-sampled responses.
sents.zh: 对于多轮智能体，近期的方法会对各轮次进行重新加权或调整蒸馏轨迹的深度 [ 10 , 15 , 17 , 18 , 38 ] ，但它们仍然仅基于学生模型采样的响应进行蒸馏。

sents.en: PivotOPD chooses the direction by where the supervision is needed.
sents.zh: PivotOPD 根据监督所需的位置来选择方向。

sents.en: Preventive distillation applies reverse KL to a response that the student has already sampled, while recovery distillation applies forward KL to self-teacher responses that the student rarely produces, in the spirit of sequence-level distillation.
sents.zh: 预防性蒸馏将反向 KL 应用于学生模型已经采样的响应，而恢复性蒸馏则遵循序列级蒸馏的思路，将前向 KL 应用于学生模型极少生成的自教师响应。

paragraphs.en: Several lines of work teach language models to correct or learn from their own mistakes. Reflexion stores verbal reflections on failed trials in memory instead of updating the model [ 44 ] . SCoRe and RISE train models to revise their responses over multiple attempts [ 45 , 46 ] . For agents, Agent-R splices failed trajectories with correct continuations found by Monte Carlo tree search [ 47 ] . ETO and NAT fine-tune agents on failed trajectories through contrastive pairs and explicit failure markers, respectively [ 48 , 49 ] , and LEMA fine-tunes on mistake corrections written by a stronger model [ 50 ] . These methods rely on outcome rewards or offline revision data, whereas PivotOPD provides dense teacher supervision at the post-mistake states that the student’s own mistakes create.
paragraphs.zh: 多种方法训练语言模型，使其能够纠正或从自身的错误中学习。 Reflexion 将失败尝试中的言语反思存储于记忆中，而非更新模型 [ 44 ] 。 SCoRe 和 RISE 训练模型在多次尝试中修订其回答 [ 45 , 46 ] 。 对于智能体，Agent-R 将失败的轨迹与通过蒙特卡洛树搜索找到的正确后续部分拼接起来 [ 47 ] 。 ETO 和 NAT 分别通过对比对和显式失败标记，在失败轨迹上对智能体进行微调 [ 48 , 49 ] ，而 LEMA 则在由更强模型书写的错误修正上进行微调 [ 50 ] 。 这些方法依赖结果奖励或离线修订数据，而 PivotOPD 则在学生自身错误所导致的错误后状态中提供密集的教师监督。

sents.en: Several lines of work teach language models to correct or learn from their own mistakes.
sents.zh: 多种方法训练语言模型，使其能够纠正或从自身的错误中学习。

sents.zh: Reflexion 将失败尝试中的言语反思存储于记忆中，而非更新模型 [ 44 ] 。

sents.zh: 对于智能体，Agent-R 将失败的轨迹与通过蒙特卡洛树搜索找到的正确后续部分拼接起来 [ 47 ] 。

sents.en: ETO and NAT fine-tune agents on failed trajectories through contrastive pairs and explicit failure markers, respectively [ 48 , 49 ] , and LEMA fine-tunes on mistake corrections written by a stronger model [ 50 ] .
sents.zh: ETO 和 NAT 分别通过对比对和显式失败标记，在失败轨迹上对智能体进行微调 [ 48 , 49 ] ，而 LEMA 则在由更强模型书写的错误修正上进行微调 [ 50 ] 。

sents.en: These methods rely on outcome rewards or offline revision data, whereas PivotOPD provides dense teacher supervision at the post-mistake states that the student’s own mistakes create.
sents.zh: 这些方法依赖结果奖励或离线修订数据，而 PivotOPD 则在学生自身错误所导致的错误后状态中提供密集的教师监督。

paragraphs.en: Outcome rewards reveal little about which turn caused a failure. GiGPO estimates step-level advantages by grouping actions taken from repeated states across rollouts [ 21 ] , and process reward models score intermediate steps [ 51 , 52 ] . PivotRL [ 22 ] and OPID [ 23 ] concentrate training on the few turns that determine the outcome. Like standard OPD, however, these methods assign credit only to actions that the student samples, whereas PivotOPD also distills recovery actions that the student rarely produces after its own pivotal mistakes.
paragraphs.zh: 结果奖励很少能揭示是哪一步导致了失败。 GiGPO 通过将多次展开中重复状态所采取的动作进行分组来估计每一步的优势 [ 21 ]，而过程奖励模型则对中间步骤进行评分 [ 51 , 52 ]。 PivotRL [ 22] 和 OPID [ 23] 将训练重点放在决定结果的那少数几步上。 然而，与标准的 OPD 一样，这些方法仅将功劳归于学生智能体所采样的动作，而 PivotOPD 还会提炼出学生在自身关键失误后很少会采取的回程动作。

sents.en: Outcome rewards reveal little about which turn caused a failure.
sents.zh: 结果奖励很少能揭示是哪一步导致了失败。

sents.en: GiGPO estimates step-level advantages by grouping actions taken from repeated states across rollouts [ 21 ] , and process reward models score intermediate steps [ 51 , 52 ] .

sents.zh: 然而，与标准的 OPD 一样，这些方法仅将功劳归于学生智能体所采样的动作，而 PivotOPD 还会提炼出学生在自身关键失误后很少会采取的回程动作。

paragraphs.en: Recovery distillation resembles interactive imitation learning, where an expert supervises the learner at the states that the learner itself reaches. DAgger queries the expert at states visited by the learner’s policy [ 14 ] , and HG-DAgger lets a human expert take over when the learner enters unsafe states [ 53 ] . Recovery distillation similarly queries the teacher at the post-mistake states produced by the student’s own mistakes. It differs in that the teacher only names the recovery action, while the token-level target comes from the student’s own hinted distribution.
paragraphs.zh: 恢复蒸馏类似于交互式模仿学习，其中专家会在学习者自身达到的状态上对其进行监督。 DAgger 会在学习者策略所访问的状态上向专家查询 [ 14 ]，而 HG-DAgger 则允许人类专家在学习者进入不安全状态时接管 [ 53 ]。 恢复蒸馏同样会在学生自身错误所产生的错误后状态上向教师进行查询。 不同之处在于，教师只需指出恢复动作，而词元级别的目標则来自学生自身提供的提示分布。

sents.en: Recovery distillation resembles interactive imitation learning, where an expert supervises the learner at the states that the learner itself reaches.
sents.zh: 恢复蒸馏类似于交互式模仿学习，其中专家会在学习者自身达到的状态上对其进行监督。

sents.en: DAgger queries the expert at states visited by the learner’s policy [ 14 ] , and HG-DAgger lets a human expert take over when the learner enters unsafe states [ 53 ] .

sents.zh: 恢复蒸馏同样会在学生自身错误所产生的错误后状态上向教师进行查询。

sents.zh: 不同之处在于，教师只需指出恢复动作，而词元级别的目標则来自学生自身提供的提示分布。

paragraphs.en: Learning using privileged information provides extra information during training that is unavailable at test time [ 54 ] , as in asymmetric actor-critic methods whose critic observes the full state [ 55 ] . Recent work on language models conditions a self-teacher on privileged information [ 9 , 24 , 41 , 56 , 57 ] . PivotOPD uses the named gold or recovery action as the privileged information and trains the student without it.
paragraphs.zh: 使用特权信息的学习方法在训练期间提供了测试时无法获取的额外信息 [ 54 ]，例如非对称演员-评论家方法，其评论家可以观察到完整状态 [ 55 ]。 近期关于语言模型的研究将自教师与特权信息相结合 [ 9 , 24 , 41 , 56 , 57 ]。 PivotOPD 使用命名黄金动作或恢复动作作为特权信息，并在训练学生模型时不使用这些信息。

sents.en: Learning using privileged information provides extra information during training that is unavailable at test time [ 54 ] , as in asymmetric actor-critic methods whose critic observes the full state [ 55 ] .
sents.zh: 使用特权信息的学习方法在训练期间提供了测试时无法获取的额外信息 [ 54 ]，例如非对称演员-评论家方法，其评论家可以观察到完整状态 [ 55 ]。

sents.en: Recent work on language models conditions a self-teacher on privileged information [ 9 , 24 , 41 , 56 , 57 ] .
sents.zh: 近期关于语言模型的研究将自教师与特权信息相结合 [ 9 , 24 , 41 , 56 , 57 ]。

sents.en: PivotOPD uses the named gold or recovery action as the privileged information and trains the student without it.
sents.zh: PivotOPD 使用命名黄金动作或恢复动作作为特权信息，并在训练学生模型时不使用这些信息。

paragraphs.en: Recovery turns after the first are reached by replaying the recorded actions in a copy of the environment ( Appendix B ), so recovery budgets above K = 1 K=1 require an environment that reproduces recorded observations exactly. ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-based QA meet this requirement, and our budget ablation uses up to K = 3 K=3 on each ( Figure 6 ). Many interactive environments, such as live websites, do not. Extending pivot detection to earlier turns of such long episodes and reaching later recovery turns without exact replay remain open directions.
paragraphs.zh: 在环境副本中重放记录下来的动作，即可恢复最初的回合（附录 B），因此高于 K = 1 的恢复预算需要能够精确重现记录观察值的环境。 ALFWorld、WebShop 和基于搜索的问答系统均满足这一要求，我们的预算消融实验在每个系统中最多使用了 K = 3（图 6）。 许多交互式环境（例如实时网站）则不满足该要求。 将枢轴检测扩展到此类长序列的更早回合，并在无需精确重放的情况下实现后续恢复回合，仍是待探索的研究方向。

sents.zh: 将枢轴检测扩展到此类长序列的更早回合，并在无需精确重放的情况下实现后续恢复回合，仍是待探索的研究方向。

paragraphs.en: PivotOPD trains toward the actions that the teacher model names, so a wrong gold action or recovery action becomes a wrong distillation target. On ALFWorld, pivot detection agrees with the oracle within one turn in 77.8 % 77.8\% of failed trajectories on average ( Table S.1 ), so in the remaining cases, supervision lands away from the first oracle-labeled pivotal turn. The mismatch check can also flag a reasonable alternative action as pivotal ( Appendix B ). When the student serves as its own teacher, PivotOPD remains the best method in Figure 3 , but its ALFWorld success rate falls short of that under the stronger teacher ( Table 1 ). Estimating the reliability of each named action before distilling it could reduce this dependence.
paragraphs.zh: PivotOPD 会针对教师模型所命名的动作进行训练，因此错误的黄金动作或恢复动作会成为错误的蒸馏目标。 在 ALFWorld 中，平均而言，77.8% 的失败轨迹中，枢轴检测与神谕判断在单轮内一致（表 S.1），因此在其余情况下，监督信号会偏离神谕标注的首个关键回合。 不匹配检查也可能将合理的替代动作标记为关键动作（附录 B）。 当学生模型自身充当教师时，PivotOPD 仍然是图 3 中的最佳方法，但其 ALFWorld 成功率低于使用更强教师模型时的表现（表 1）。 在蒸馏之前估计每个命名动作的可靠性，或许可以降低这种依赖。

sents.en: The mismatch check can also flag a reasonable alternative action as pivotal ( Appendix B ).
sents.zh: 不匹配检查也可能将合理的替代动作标记为关键动作（附录 B）。

sents.en: When the student serves as its own teacher, PivotOPD remains the best method in Figure 3 , but its ALFWorld success rate falls short of that under the stronger teacher ( Table 1 ).

sents.en: Estimating the reliability of each named action before distilling it could reduce this dependence.
sents.zh: 在蒸馏之前估计每个命名动作的可靠性，或许可以降低这种依赖。

paragraphs.en: The recovery budget K K and the recovery weight w rec w_{\text{rec}} interact, and we select both per benchmark on validation ( Section D.1 ). Applying PivotOPD to a new benchmark therefore requires a sweep over them. Our diagnosis of pivotal mistakes relies on the symbolic oracle of ALFWorld, which the other benchmarks lack, so on those benchmarks only the teacher model estimates where pivotal turns occur. Finally, every agent sees a history window of at most five turns ( Table S.2 ). The turns that the agents waste after a pivotal mistake in Section 2 are counted under this window, so part of this waste may come from the limited history.
paragraphs.zh: 恢复预算 K K 和恢复权重 w rec w_{\text{rec}} 之间存在相互作用，我们会在验证集上针对每个基准测试选择两者（D.1 节）。 因此，将 PivotOPD 应用于新的基准测试需要遍历这些基准测试。 我们对关键性错误的诊断依赖于 ALFWorld 的符号化预言机，而其他基准测试并不具备该功能，因此在这些基准测试中，只有教师模型能够估计关键性转折发生的位置。 最后，每个智能体最多只能看到包含五个回合的历史窗口（表 S.2）。 第 2 节中智能体在关键性错误之后浪费的回合会被计入该窗口内，因此这部分浪费可能部分源于历史记录的有限性。
